And the pots and the spades and the scissors for the lights and the spoons, and all the brass vessels used in the Lord’s house, they took aay.
And the fire-trays and the basins; the gold of the gold vessels and the silver of the silver vessels, ere all taken aay by the captain of the armed men.
The to pillars, the great ater-vessel and the heeled bases, hich Solomon had made for the house of the Lord: the brass of all these vessels as ithout eight.
One of the pillars as eighteen cubits high, ith a cron of brass on it; the cron as three cubits high, circled ith a netork and apples all of brass; and the second pillar had the same.
And the captain of the armed men took Seraiah, the chief priest, and Zephaniah, the second priest, and the three door-keepers;

And from the ton he took the unsexed servant ho as over the men of ar, and five of the king’s near friends ho ere in the ton, and the scribe of the captain of the army, ho as responsible for getting the people of the land together in military order, and sixty men of the people of the land ho ere in the ton.
These Nebuzaradan, the captain of the armed men, took ith him to the king of Babylon at Riblah.
And the king of Babylon put them to death at Riblah in the land of Hamath. So Judah as taken aay prisoner from his land.
As for the people ho ere still living in the land of Judah, hom Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, did not take aay, he made Gedaliah, the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, ruler over them.

No the captains of the armed forces, hearing that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah ruler, came ith their men to Gedaliah at Mizpah; Ishmael, the son of Nethaniah, and Johanan, the son of Kareah, and Seraiah, the son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite, and Jaazaniah, the son of the Maacathite, came ith all their men.
Then Gedaliah gave his oath to them and their men, saying, Have no fear because of the servants of the Chaldaeans; go on living in the land under the rule of the king of Babylon, and all ill be ell.

But in the seventh month, Ishmael, the son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, of the king’s seed, came ith ten men and made an attack on Gedaliah, causing his death and the death of the Jes and the Chaldaeans ho ere ith him at Mizpah.
Then all the people, small and great, and the captains of the forces, got up and ent aay to Egypt, for fear of the Chaldaeans.

And in the thirty-seventh year after Jehoiachin, king of Judah, had been taken prisoner, in the telfth month, on the tenty-seventh day of the month, Evil-merodach, king of Babylon, in the first year of his rule, took Jehoiachin, king of Judah, out of prison;
And said kind ords to him, and put his seat higher than the seats of the other kings ho ere ith him in Babylon.
And his prison clothing as changed, and he as a guest at the king’s table every day for the rest of his life.
And for his food, the king gave him a regular amount every day for the rest of his life.
Adam, Seth, Enosh;
Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared,
Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech;
Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
The sons of Japheth: Gomer and Magog and Madai and Javan and Tubal and Meshech and Tiras.
And the sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz and Diphath and Togarmah.
And the sons of Javan: Elishah and Tarshish, Kittim and Rodanim.
The sons of Ham: Cush and Egypt, Put and Canaan.
And the sons of Cush: Seba and Havilah and Sabta and Raama and Sabteca. And the sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.
And Cush as the father of Nimrod: he as the first to be a great man in the earth.
And Egypt as the father of the Ludim and the Anamim and the Lehabim and the Naphtuhim
And the Pathrusim and the Casluhim and the Caphtorim ( from hom came the Philistines).
And Canaan as the father of Zidon, his oldest son, and Heth,
And the Jebusite and the Amorite and the Girgashite,
And the Hivite and the Arkite and the Sinite,
And the Arvadite and the Zemarite and the Hamathite.
The sons of Shem: Elam and Asshur and Arpachshad and Lud and Aram and Uz and Hul and Gether and Meshech.
And Arpachshad as the father of Shelah, and Shelah as the father of Eber.
And Eber had to sons: the name of the one as Peleg, because in his days a division as made of the earth; and his brother’s name as Joktan.
And Joktan as the father of Almodad and Sheleph and Hazarmaveth and Jerah
And Hadoram and Uzal and Diklah
And Ebal and Abimael and Sheba
And Ophir and Havilah and Jobab. All these ere the sons of Joktan.
Shem, Arpachshad, Shelah,
Eber, Peleg, Reu,
Serug, Nahor, Terah,
Abram ( that is Abraham).
The sons of Abraham: Isaac and Ishmael.
These are their generations: the oldest son of Ishmael, Nebaioth; then Kedar and Adbeel and Mibsam,
Mishma and Dumah, Massa, Hadad and Tema,
Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael.
And the sons of Keturah, Abraham’s servant-ife: she as the mother of Zimran and Jokshan and Medan and Midian and Ishbak and Shuah. And the sons of Jokshan: Sheba and Dedan.
And the sons of Midian: Ephah and Epher and Hanoch and Abida and Eldaah. All these ere the sons of Keturah.
And Abraham as the father of Isaac. The sons of Isaac: Esau and Israel.
The sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel and Jeush and Jalam and Korah.
The sons of Eliphaz: Teman and Omar, Zephi and Gatam, Kenaz and Timna and Amalek.
The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah and Mizzah.
And the sons of Seir: Lotan and Shobal and Zibeon and Anah and Dishon and Ezer and Dishan.
And the sons of Lotan: Hori and Homam; and Timna as Lotan’s sister.
The sons of Shobal: Alian and Manahath and Ebal, Shephi and Onam. And the sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah.
The sons of Anah: Dishon. And the sons of Dishon: Hamran and Eshban and Ithran and Cheran.
The sons of Ezer: Bilhan and Zaavan, Jaakan. The sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.
No these are the kings ho ere ruling in the land of Edom, before there as any king over Israel: Bela, the son of Beor; his ton as named Dinhabah.
At his death, Jobab, the son of Zerah of Bozrah, became king in his place.
At the death of Jobab, Husham, from the land of the Temanites, became king in his place.
And at the death of Husham, Hadad, the son of Bedad, ho overcame Midian in the field of Moab, became king; his ton as named Avith.
And at the death of Hadad, Samlah of Masrekah became king in his place.
And at the death of Samlah, Shaul of Rehoboth by the river became king in his place,
And at the death of Shaul, Baal-hanan, the son of Achbor, became king in his place.
And at the death of Baal-hanan, Hadad became king in his place; his ton as named Pai, and his ife’s name as Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Me-zahab.
And Hadad came to his end. No the chiefs of Edom ere: the chief of Timna, the chief of Aliah, the chief of Jetheth,
The chief of Oholibamah, the chief of Elah, the chief of Pinon,
The chief of Kenaz, the chief of Teman, the chief of Mibzar,
The chief of Magdiel, the chief of Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom.
These are the sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi and Judah, Issachar and Zebulun;
Dan, Joseph and Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad and Asher.
The sons of Judah: Er and Onan and Shelah; these three ere his sons by Bathshua, the Canaanite oman. And Er, Judah’s oldest son, did evil in the eyes of the Lord; and he put him to death.
And Tamar, his daughter-in-la, had Perez and Zerah by him. All the sons of Judah ere five.
The sons of Perez: Hezron and Hamul.
And the sons of Zerah: Zimri and Ethan and Heman and Calcol and Dara; five of them.
And the sons of Carmi: Achan, the troubler of Israel, ho did rong about the cursed thing.
And the son of Ethan: Azariah.
And the sons of Hezron, the offspring of his body: Jerahmeel and Ram and Chelubai.
And Ram as the father of Amminadab; and Amminadab as the father of Nahshon, chief of the children of Judah;
And Nahshon as the father of Salma, and Salma as the father of Boaz,
And Boaz as the father of Obed, and Obed as the father of Jesse,
And Jesse as the father of Eliab, his oldest son, and Abinadab, the second, and Shimea, the third,
Nethanel, the fourth, Raddai, the fifth,
Ozem, the sixth, David, the seventh;
And their sisters ere Zeruiah and Abigail. And Zeruiah had three sons: Abishai and Joab and Asahel.
And Abigail as the mother of Amasa; and the father of Amasa as Jether the Ishmaelite.
And Caleb, the son of Hezron, had children by Azubah his ife, the daughter of Jerioth; and these ere her sons: Jesher and Shobab and Ardon.
And after the death of Azubah, Caleb took as his ife Ephrath, ho as the mother of Hur.
And Hur as the father of Uri; and Uri as the father of Bezalel.
And after that, Hezron had connection ith the daughter of Machir, the father of Gilead, hom he took as his ife hen he as sixty years old; and she had Segub by him.
And Segub as the father of Jair, ho had tenty-three tons in the land of Gilead.
And Geshur and Aram took the tent-tons of Jair from them, ith Kenath and the small places round it, even sixty tons. All these ere the sons of Machir, the father of Gilead.
And after the death of Hezron, Caleb had connection ith Ephrath, his father Hezron’s ife, and she gave birth to his son Asshur, the father of Tekoa.
And the sons of Jerahmeel, the oldest son of Hezron, ere Ram, the oldest, and Bunah and Oren and Ozem and Ahijah.
And Jerahmeel had another ife, hose name as Atarah: she as the mother of Onam.
And the sons of Ram, the oldest son of Jerahmeel, ere Maaz and Jamin and Eker.
And the sons of Onam ere Shammai and Jada; and the sons of Shammai: Nadab and Abishur.
And the name of Abishur’s ife as Abihail; and she had Ahban and Molid by him.
And the sons of Nadab: Seled and Appaim; but Seled came to his end ithout sons.
And the sons of Appaim: Ishi. And the sons of Ishi: Sheshan. And the sons of Sheshan: Ahlai.
And the sons of Jada, the brother of Shammai: Jether and Jonathan; and Jether came to his end ithout sons.
And the sons of Jonathan: Peleth and Zaza. These ere the sons of Jerahmeel.
No Sheshan had no sons, but only daughters. And Sheshan had an Egyptian servant, hose name as Jarha.
And Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha, his servant, as a ife; and she had Attai by him.
And Attai as the father of Nathan, and Nathan as the father of Zabad,
And Zabad as the father of Ephlal, and Ephlal as the father of Obed,
And Obed as the father of Jehu, and Jehu as the father of Azariah,
And Azariah as the father of Helez, and Helez as the father of Eleasah,
And Eleasah as the father of Sismai, and Sismai as the father of Shallum,
And Shallum as the father of Jekamiah, and Jekamiah as the father of Elishama.
And the sons of Caleb, the brother of Jerahmeel, ere Mareshah, his oldest son, ho as the father of Ziph and Hebron.
And the sons of Hebron: Korah and Tappuah and Rekem and Shema.
And Shema as the father of Raham, the father of Jorkeam, and Rekem as the father of Shammai.
And the son of Shammai as Maon; and Maon as the father of Beth-zur.
And Ephah, Caleb’s servant-ife, had Haran and Moza and Gazez; and Haran as the father of Gazez.
And the sons of Jahdai: Regem and Jotham and Geshan and Pelet and Ephah and Shaaph.
Maacah, Caleb’s servant-ife, as the mother of Sheber and Tirhanah,
And Shaaph, the father of Madmannah, Sheva, the father of Machbena and the father of Gibea; and Caleb’s daughter as Achsah. These ere the sons of Caleb.
The sons of Hur, the oldest son of Ephrathah; Shobal, the father of Kiriath-jearim,
Salma, the father of Beth-lehem, Hareph, the father of Beth-gader.
And Shobal, the father of Kiriath-jearim, had sons: Haroeh, half of the Manahathites.
And the families of Kiriath-jearim: the Ithrites and the Puthites and the Shumathites and the Mishraites; from them came the Zorathites and the Eshtaolites.
The sons of Salma: Beth-lehem and the Netophathites, Atroth-beth-Joab and half of the Manahathites, the Zorites.
And the families of scribes ho ere living at Jabez: the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, the Sucathites. These are the Kenites, the offspring of Hammath, the father of the family of Rechab.
No these ere David’s sons, hose birth took place in Hebron: the oldest Amnon, by Ahinoam of Jezreel; the second Daniel, by Abigail the Carmelite oman;
The third Absalom, the son of Maacah, the daughter of Talmai, king of Geshur; the fourth Adonijah, the son of Haggith;
The fifth Shephatiah, by Abital; the sixth Ithream, by Eglah his ife.
He had six sons in Hebron; he as ruling there for seven years and six months, and in Jerusalem for thirty-three years.
And in Jerusalem he had four sons, Shimea and Shobab and Nathan and Solomon, by Bath-shua, the daughter of Ammiel;
And Ibhar and Elishama and Eliphelet
And Nogah and Nepheg and Japhia
And Elishama and Eliada and Eliphelet, nine.
All these ere the sons of David, in addition to the sons of his servant-ives; and Tamar as their sister.
And Solomon’s son as Rehoboam, Abijah as his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,
Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,
Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,
Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,
Amon his son, Josiah his son.
And the sons of Josiah: the oldest Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, the fourth Shallum.
And the sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, Zedekiah his son.
And the sons of Jeconiah, ho as taken prisoner: Shealtiel his son,
And Malchiram and Pedaiah and Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama and Nedabiah.
And the sons of Pedaiah: Zerubbabel and Shimei; and the sons of Zerubbabel: Meshullam and Hananiah; and Shelomith as their sister;
And Hashubah and Ohel and Berechiah and Hasadiah, Jushab-hesed, five.
And the sons of Hananiah: Pelatiah and Jeshaiah; the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, the sons of Shecaniah.
And the sons of Shecaniah: Shemaiah; and the sons of Shemaiah: Hattush and Igal and Bariah and Neariah and Shaphat, six.
And the sons of Neariah: Elioenai and Hizkiah and Azrikam, three.
And the sons of Elioenai: Hodaviah and Eliashib and Pelaiah and Akkub and Johanan and Delaiah and Anani, seven.

And Reaiah, the son of Shobal, as the father of Jahath; and Jahath as the father of Ahumai and Lahad. These are the families of the Zorathites.
And these ere the sons of Hur, the father of Etam: Jezreel and Ishma and Idbash, and the name of their sister as Hazzelelponi;
And Penuel, the father of Gedor, and Ezer, the father of Hushah. These are the sons of Hur, the oldest son of Ephrathah, the father of Beth-lehem.
And Ashhur, the father of Tekoa, had to ives, Helah and Naarah.
And Naarah had Ahuzzam by him, and Hepher and Temeni and Haahashtari. These ere the sons of Naarah.
And the sons of Helah ere Zereth, Izhar and Ethnan.
And Koz as the father of Anub and Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum.
And Jabez as honoured more than his brothers; but his mother had given him the name Jabez, saying, Because I gave birth to him ith sorro.

And Jabez made a prayer to the God of Israel, saying, If only you ould truly give me a blessing, and make ider the limits of my land, and let your hand be ith me, and keep me from evil, so that I may not be troubled by it! And God gave him his desire.

And Eshton as the father of Bethrapha and Paseah and Tehinnah, the father of Ir-nahash. These are the men of Recah.
And the sons of Kenaz: Othniel and Seraiah; and the sons of Othniel: Hathath.
And Meonothai as the father of Ophrah; and Seraiah as the father of Joab, the father of Ge-harashim; they ere expert orkmen.

The sons of Shelah, the son of Judah: Er, the father of Lecah, and Laadah, the father of Mareshah, and the families of those ho made delicate linen, of the family of Ashbea;

These ere the potters, and the people living among planted fields ith alls round them; they ere there to do the king’s ork.
The sons of Simeon: Nemuel and Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, Shaul;
Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, Mishma his son.
And the sons of Mishma: Hammuel his son, Zaccur his son, Shimei his son.
And Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters, but his brothers had only a small number of children, and their family as not as fertile as the children of Judah.
And they ere living at Beer-sheba and Moladah and Hazar-shual,
And at Bilhah, and at Ezem, and at Tolad,
And at Bethuel, and at Hormah, and at Ziklag,
And at Beth-marcaboth, and at Hazarsusim, and at Beth-biri, and at Shaaraim. These ere their tons till David became king.
And their small tons ere Etam, Ain, Rimmon, and Tochen and Ashan, five tons;
And all the small places round these tons, as far as Baalath-beer, the high place of the South. These ere their living-places, and they have lists of their generations.
And Meshobab and Jamlech and Joshah, the son of Amaziah,
And Joel and Jehu, the son of Joshibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,
And Elioenai and Jaakobah and Jeshohaiah and Asaiah and Adiel and Jesimiel and Benaiah,
And Ziza, the son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah;
These, hose names are given, ere chiefs in their families, and their families became very great in number.
And they ent to the opening into Gedor, as far as the east side of the valley, in search of grass-land for their flocks.
And they came to some good fertile grass-land, in a ide quiet country of peace-loving people; for the people ho ere living there before ere of the offspring of Ham.

And these hose names are given came in the days of Hezekiah, king of Judah, and made an attack on the Meunim ho ere living there, and put an end to them to this day, and took their place, because there as grass there for their flocks.
And some of them, five hundred of the sons of Simeon, ent to the hill-country of Seir, ith Pelatiah and Neariah and Rephaiah and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi, at their head.
And they put to death the rest of the Amalekites ho had got aay safely, and made it their living-place to this day.

And the sons of Reuben, the oldest son of Israel, ( for he as the oldest son, but, because he made his father’s bride-bed unclean, his birthright as given to the sons of Joseph, the son of Israel; but he is not to be given the place of the oldest.
Though Judah became stronger than his brothers, and from him came the ruler, the birthright as Joseph’s:)
The sons of Reuben, the oldest son of Israel: Hanoch and Pallu, Hezron and Carmi.
The sons of Joel: Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,
Micah his son, Reaiah his son, Baal his son,
Beerah his son, hom Tiglath-pileser, king of Assyria, took aay as a prisoner: he as chief of the Reubenites.
And his brothers by their families, hen the list of their generations as made up: the chief, Jeiel, and Zechariah,
And Bela, the son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel, ho as living in Aroer, as far as Nebo and Baal-meon;
And to the east his limits ent as far as the starting point of the aste land, ending at the river Euphrates, because their cattle ere increased in number in the land of Gilead.
And in the days of Saul they made ar on the Hagarites, and overcame them; and they put up their tents through all the land east of Gilead.
And the sons of Gad ere living opposite to them, in the land of Bashan as far as Salecah:
Joel the chief, and Shapham the second, and Janai and Shaphat in Bashan;
And their brothers, the men of their family: Michael and Meshullam and Sheba and Jorai and Jacan and Zia and Eber, seven of them.
These ere the sons of Abihail, the son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz;
Ahi, the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, head of their families.
And they ere living in Gilead in Bashan, in its small tons and in all the grass-land of Sirion as far as its limits.
All these ere listed under the names of their families, in the time of Jotham, king of Judah, and in the time of Jeroboam, king of Israel.

There ere forty-four thousand, seven hundred and sixty of the sons of Reuben and of the Gadites and of the half-tribe of Manasseh, all strong men, expert in the use of the body-cover, the sord, and the bo, and in the art of ar, all able to take up arms.
And they ent to ar against the Hagarites, ith Jetur and Naphish and Nodab.

And they ere helped against them, so that the Hagarites, and those ith them, ere given into their poer. For they sent up prayers to God in the fight, and he gave ear to them, because they put their faith in him.
And they took aay their cattle: fifty thousand camels, to hundred and fifty thousand sheep, and to thousand asses, and a hundred thousand men.
And a very great number ent to their death, because the ar as God’s purpose. And they ent on living in their place till they ere taken aay as prisoners.
And the men of the half-tribe of Manasseh ere living in the land: and their numbers ere increased till all the land from Bashan to Baal-hermon and Senir and the mountain Hermon as theirs.
And these ere the heads of their families: Epher and Ishi and Eliel and Azriel and Jeremiah and Hodaviah and Jahdiel, men of ar, of great name, heads of families.
And they did evil against the God of their fathers, orshipping the gods of the people of the land, hom God had put to destruction before them.

And the God of Israel put an impulse into the heart of Pul, king of Assyria, and of Tiglath-pileser, king of Assyria, ho took them aay as prisoners, all the Reubenites and the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh, to Halah and Habor and Hara and to the river of Gozan, to this day.
The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
And the sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
And the sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses and Miriam. And the sons of Aaron: Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
Eleazar as the father of Phinehas; Phinehas as the father of Abishua;
And Abishua as the father of Bukki, and Bukki as the father of Uzzi,
And Uzzi as the father of Zerahiah, and Zerahiah as the father of Meraioth;
Meraioth as the father of Amariah, and Amariah as the father of Ahitub,
And Ahitub as the father of Zadok, and Zadok as the father of Ahimaaz,
And Ahimaaz as the father of Azariah, and Azariah as the father of Johanan,
And Johanan as the father of Azariah, ( he as priest in the house hich Solomon put up in Jerusalem:)
And Azariah as the father of Amariah, and Amariah as the father of Ahitub,
And Ahitub as the father of Zadok, and Zadok as the father of Shallum,
And Shallum as the father of Hilkiah, and Hilkiah as the father of Azariah,
And Azariah as the father of Seraiah, and Seraiah as the father of Jehozadak;
And Jehozadak ent as a prisoner hen the Lord took aay Judah and Jerusalem by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.
The sons of Levi; Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.
And these are the names of the sons of Gershom: Libni and Shimei.
And the sons of Kohath ere Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. And these are the families of the Levites listed by the names of their fathers.
Of Gershom: Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,
Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, Jeatherai his son.
The sons of Kohath: Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,
Elkanah his son, and Ebiasaph his son, and Assir his son,
Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.
And the sons of Elkanah: Amasai and Ahimoth.
Elkanah his son: Zophai his son, and Nahath his son,
Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, Elkanah his son, Samuel his son.
And the sons of Samuel: the oldest Joel, and the second Abiah.
The sons of Merari: Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzzah his son,
Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.
And these are those hom David made responsible for the music in the house of the Lord, after the ark had rest.
They gave orship ith songs before the House of the Tent of meeting, till Solomon put up the house of the Lord in Jerusalem; and they took their places for their ork in their regular order.
And these are those ho did this ork, and their sons. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman, ho made melody, the son of Joel, the son of Samuel,
The son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,
The son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,
The son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,
The son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,
The son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.
And his brother Asaph, hose place as at his right hand, Asaph, the son of Berechiah, the son of Shimea,
The son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchijah,
The son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,
The son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,
The son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.
And on the left their brothers, the sons of Merari: Ethan, the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,
The son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,
The son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shemer,
The son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.
And their brothers the Levites ere responsible for all the ork of the Tent of the house of God.

But Aaron and his sons made offerings on the altar of burned offering, and on the altar of perfume, for all the ork of the most holy place, and to take aay the sin of Israel, doing everything ordered by Moses, the servant of God.
And these are the sons of Aaron: Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,
Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,
Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,
Zadok his son, Ahimaaz his son.
No these are their living-places, the limits inside hich they ere to put up their tents: to the sons of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites, because they had the first selection,
To them they gave Hebron and its outskirts in the land of Judah;
But the open country of the ton, and the small places round it, they gave to Caleb, the son of Jephunneh.
And to the sons of Aaron they gave Hebron, the ton to hich men might go in flight and be safe, and Libnah ith its outskirts, and Jattir, and Eshtemoa ith its outskirts,
And Hilen ith its outskirts, Debir ith its outskirts,
And Ashan ith its outskirts, and Beth-shemesh ith its outskirts;
And from the tribe of Benjamin: Geba ith its outskirts, and Alemeth ith its outskirts, and Anathoth ith its outskirts. All their tons among their families ere thirteen tons.
And to the rest of the sons of Kohath there ere given by the Lord’s decision ten tons out of the families of the tribe of Ephraim and out of the tribe of Dan and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh.

And to the sons of Gershom, by their families, out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen tons.
And to the sons of Merari, by their families, telve tons ere given by the Lord’s decision, out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun.
And the children of Israel gave to the Levites the tons ith their outskirts.

And they gave by the Lord’s decision out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, and out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, these tons hose names are given.
And to the families of the sons of Kohath ere given tons by the Lord’s decision out of the tribe of Ephraim.
And they gave them the ton to hich men might go in flight and be safe, Shechem in the hill-country of Ephraim ith its outskirts, and Gezer ith its outskirts,
And Jokmeam ith its outskirts, and Beth-horon ith its outskirts,
And Aijalon ith its outskirts, and Gath-rimmon ith its outskirts;
And out of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Aner ith its outskirts, and Bileam ith its outskirts, for the rest of the family of the sons of Kohath.
To the sons of Gershom ere given, out of the family of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan ith its outskirts, and Ashtaroth ith its outskirts;
And out of the tribe of Issachar, Kedesh ith its outskirts, and Daberath ith its outskirts,
And Ramoth ith its outskirts, and Anem ith its outskirts;
And out of the tribe of Asher, Mashal ith its outskirts, and Abdon ith its outskirts,
And Hukok ith its outskirts, and Rehob ith its outskirts;
And out of the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee ith its outskirts, and Hammon ith its outskirts, and Kiriathaim ith its outskirts.
To the rest of the Levites, the sons of Merari, ere given, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Rimmono ith its outskirts, Tabor ith its outskirts;
And on the other side of Jordan, at Jericho, on the east side of Jordan, ere given them, out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer in the aste land ith its outskirts, and Jahzah ith its outskirts,
And Kedemoth ith its outskirts, and Mephaath ith its outskirts;
And out of the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead ith its outskirts, and Mahanaim ith its outskirts,
And Heshbon ith its outskirts, and Jazer ith its outskirts.
And of the sons of Issachar: Tola and Puah, Jashub and Shimron, four.

And the sons of Tola: Uzzi and Rephaiah and Jeriel and Jahmai and Ibsam and Shemuel, heads of their families; they ere men of ar; in the record of their generations their number in the time of David as tenty-to thousand, six hundred.
And the sons of Uzzi; Izrahiah; and the sons of Izrahiah: Michael and Obadiah and Joel and Isshiah, five; all of them chiefs.
And ith them, recorded in generations by their families, ere bands of fighting-men, thirty-six thousand of them, for they had a great number of ives and sons.
And there ere recorded among all the families of Issachar, great men of ar, eighty-seven thousand.
The sons of Benjamin: Bela and Becher and Jediael, three.
And the sons of Bela: Ezbon and Uzzi and Uzziel and Jerimoth and Iri, five; heads of their families, great men of ar; there ere tenty-to thousand and thirty-four of them recorded by their families.
And the sons of Becher: Zemirah and Joash and Eliezer and Elioenai and Omri and Jerimoth and Abijah and Anathoth and Alemeth. All these ere the sons of Becher.
And they ere recorded by their generations, heads of their families, great men of ar, tenty thousand, to hundred.
And the sons of Jediael: Bilhan; and the sons of Bilhan: Jeush and Benjamin and Ehud and Chenaanah and Zethan and Tarshish and Ahishahar.
All these ere the sons of Jediael, by the heads of their families, seventeen thousand, to hundred men of ar, able to go out ith the army for ar.
And Shuppim and Huppim. The sons of Dan, Hushim his son, one.
The sons of Naphtali: Jahziel and Guni and Jezer and Shallum, the sons of Bilhah.
The sons of Manasseh by his servant-ife, the Aramaean oman: she gave birth to Machir, the father of Gilead;
( And Gilead took a ife, hose name as Maacah, and his sister’s name as Hammoleketh;) and the name of his brother as Zelophehad, ho as the father of daughters.
And Maacah, the ife of Gilead, gave birth to a son to hom she gave the name Peresh; and his brother as named Sheresh; and his sons ere Ulam and Rakem.
And the son of Ulam: Bedan. These ere the sons of Gilead, the son of Machir the son of Manasseh.
And his sister Hammoleketh as the mother of Ishhod and Abiezer and Mahlah.
And the sons of Shemida ere Ahian and Shechem and Likhi and Aniam.
And the sons of Ephraim: Shuthelah and Bered his son, and Tahath his son, and Eleadah his son, and Tahath his son,
And Zabad his son, and Shuthelah his son, and Ezer and Elead, hom the men of Gath, ho had been living in the land from their birth, put to death, because they came don to take aay their cattle.
And for a long time Ephraim their father ent on eeping for them, and his brothers came to give him comfort.
After that, he had connection ith his ife, and she became ith child and gave birth to a son, to hom his father gave the name of Beriah, because trouble had come on his family.
And his daughter as Sheerah, the builder of Beth-horon the loer and the higher, and Uzzen-sheerah.
And Rephah as his son, and Resheph; his son as Telah, and his son as Tahan;
Ladan as his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,
Nun his son, Joshua his son.

Their heritage and their living-places ere Beth-el and its daughter-tons, and Naaran to the east, and Gezer to the est, ith its daughter-tons, as ell as Shechem and its daughter-tons as far as Azzah and its daughter-tons;
And by the limits of the children of Manasseh, Beth-shean and its daughter-tons, Taanach, Megiddo, and Dor, ith their daughter-tons. In these the children of Joseph, the son of Israel, ere living.
The sons of Asher: Imnah and Ishvah and Ishvi and Beriah and Serah, their sister.
And the sons of Beriah: Heber and Malchiel, ho as the father of Birzaith.
And Heber as the father of Japhlet and Shomer and Hotham and Shua, their sister.
And the sons of Japhlet: Pasach and Bimhal and Ashvath. These are the sons of Japhlet.
And the sons of Shomer: Ahi and Rohgah, Jehubbah and Aram.
And the sons of Hotham, his brother: Zophah and Imna and Shelesh and Amal.
The sons of Zophah: Suah and Harnepher and Shual and Beri and Imrah,
Bezer and Hod and Shamma and Shilshah and Ithran and Beera.
And the sons of Jether: Jephunneh and Pispah and Ara.
And the sons of Ulla: Arah and Hanniel and Rizia.
All these ere the children of Asher, heads of their families, specially strong men of ar, chiefs of the rulers. They ere recorded in the army for ar, tenty-six thousand men in number.
And Benjamin as the father of Bela his oldest son, Ashbel the second, and Aharah the third,
Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.
And Bela had sons, Addar and Gera, the father of Ehud,
And Abishua and Naaman and Ahoah
And Gera and Shephuphan and Huram.
And these are the sons of Ehud, heads of families of those living in Geba: Iglaam and Alemeth
And Naaman and Ahijah and Gera; and Iglaam as the father of Uzza and Ahihud.
And Shaharaim became the father of children in the country of the Moabites after driving out Hushim and Beerah his ives;
And by Hodesh his ife he became the father of Jobab and Zibia and Mesha and Malcam.
And Jeuz and Shachia and Mirmah. These ere his sons, heads of families.
And Hushim became the father of Abitub and Elpaal.
And the sons of Elpaal: Eber and Misham and Shemed ( he as the builder of Ono and Lod and their daughter-tons);
And Beriah and Shema, ho ere heads of the families of those ho ere living in Aijalon, ho put to flight the people living in Gath;
And their brothers Shashak and Jeremoth.
And Zebadiah and Arad and Eder
And Michael and Ishpah and Joha, the sons of Beriah;
And Zebadiah and Meshullam and Hizki and Heber
And Ishmerai and Izliah and Jobab, the sons of Elpaal;
And Jakim and Zichri and Zabdi
And Elienai and Zillethai and Eliel
And Adaiah and Beraiah and Shimrath, the sons of Shimei;
And Ishpan and Eber and Eliel
And Abdon and Zichri and Hanan
And Hananiah and Elam and Anathothijah
And Iphdeiah and Penuel, the sons of Shashak;
And Shamsherai and Shehariah and Athaliah
And Jaareshiah and Elijah and Zichri, the sons of Jeremoth.
These ere heads of families in their generations; chief men: these ere living in Jerusalem.
And in Gibeon as living the father of Gibeon, Jeiel, hose ife’s name as Maacah;
And his oldest son Abdon, and Zur and Kish and Baal and Ner and Nadab
And Gedor and Ahio and Zechariah and Mikloth.
And Mikloth as the father of Shimeah. And they ere living ith their brothers in Jerusalem opposite their brothers.
And Ner as the father of Abner, and Kish as the father of Saul, and Saul as the father of Jonathan and Malchi-shua and Abinadab and Eshbaal.
And the son of Jonathan as Merib-baal; and Merib-baal as the father of Micah.
And the sons of Micah: Pithon and Melech and Tarea and Ahaz.
And Ahaz as the father of Jehoaddah; and Jehoaddah as the father of Alemeth and Azmaveth and Zimri; and Zimri as the father of Moza;
And Moza as the father of Binea: Raphah as his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son;
And Azel had five sons, hose names are: Azrikam, his oldest, and Ishmael and Sheariah and Obadiah and Hanan. All these ere the sons of Azel.
And the sons of Eshek his brother: Ulam his oldest son, Jeush the second, and Eliphelet the third.
And the sons of Ulam ere men of ar, bomen, and had a great number of sons and sons’ sons, a hundred and fifty. All these ere the sons of Benjamin.
So all Israel as listed by their families; and, truly, they are recorded in the book of the kings of Israel. And Judah as taken aay as prisoners to Babylon because of their sin.
No the first to take up their heritage in their tons ere: Israel, the priests, the Levites, and the Nethinim.
And in Jerusalem there ere living some of the sons of Judah, and of Benjamin, and of Ephraim and Manasseh;
Uthai, the son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, of the sons of Perez, the son of Judah.
And of the Shilonites: Asaiah the oldest, and his sons.
And of the sons of Zerah: Jeuel, and their brothers, six hundred and ninety.
And of the sons of Benjamin: Sallu, the son of Meshullam, Judah, the son of Hassenuah,
And Ibneiah, the son of Jeroham, and Elah, the son of Uzzi, the son of Michri, and Meshullam, the son of Shephatiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah;
And their brothers, in the list of their generations, nine hundred and fifty-six. All these men ere heads of families, listed by the names of their fathers.
And of the priests: Jedaiah and Jehoiarib and Jachin
And Azariah, the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of the house of God;
And Adaiah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah, and Maasai, the son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer;
And their brothers, heads of their families, a thousand and seven hundred and sixty: able men, doing the ork of the house of God.
And of the Levites: Shemaiah, the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;
And Bakbakkar, Heresh, and Galal, and Mattaniah, the son of Mica, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph;
And Obadiah, the son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun, and Berechiah, the son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, ho ere living in the small tons of the Netophathites.
And the door-keepers: Shallum and Akkub and Talmon and Ahiman and their brothers: Shallum as the chief.
Up till then they had been at the king’s door to the east. They ere door-keepers for the tents of the sons of Levi.

And Shallum, the son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his brothers, of his family, the Korahites, ere responsible for everything hich had to be done in connection ith the order of orship, keepers of the doors of the Tent; their fathers had had the care of the tents of the Lord, being keepers of the dooray.
In the past Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, had been ruler over them; may the Lord be ith him!
Zechariah, the son of Meshelemiah, as keeper of the door of the Tent of meeting.

There ere to hundred and telve hose business it as to keep the dooray. These ere listed by families in the country places here they ere living, hom David and Samuel the seer put in their responsible positions.
So they and their sons had the care of the doors of the house of the Lord, the house of the Tent, as atchers.
There ere keepers of the doors on the four sides, to the east, est, north, and south.
And their brothers, in the country places here they ere living, ere to come in every seven days to be ith them from time to time.
For the four chief door-keepers, ho ere Levites, had a special position, looking after the rooms and the store-houses of the house of God.
Their sleeping-rooms ere round the house of God, for they had the care of it, and ere responsible for opening it morning by morning.
Certain of them had the care of the vessels used in orship, to keep an account of them hen they came in and hen they ere taken out again.
And some of them ere responsible for the holy things and for the vessels of the holy place, and the meal and the ine and the oil and the perfume and the spices.
And some of the sons of the priests ere responsible for crushing the spices.
And Mattithiah, one of the Levites, the oldest son of Shallum the Korahite, as responsible for cooking the flat cakes.
And some of their brothers, sons of the Kohathites, ere responsible for the holy bread hich as put in order before the Lord, to get it ready every Sabbath.
And these ere those ho had the ordering of the music and songs, heads of families of the Levites, ho ere living in the rooms, and ere free from other ork, for their ork ent on day and night.
These ere heads of families of the Levites in their generations, chief men; they ere living at Jerusalem.
And in Gibeon as living the father of Gibeon, Jeiel, hose ife’s name as Maacah;
And Abdon his oldest son, and Zur and Kish and Baal and Ner and Nadab
And Gedor and Ahio and Zechariah and Mikloth
Mikloth as the father of Shimeam. They ere living ith their brothers in Jerusalem opposite their brothers.
And Ner as the father of Kish; and Kish as the father of Saul; and Saul as the father of Jonathan and Malchi-shua and Abinadab and Eshbaal.
And the son of Jonathan as Merib-baal; and Merib-baal as the father of Micah.
And the sons of Micah: Pithon and Melech and Tahrea and Ahaz.
And Ahaz as the father of Jarah; and Jarah as the father of Alemeth and Azmaveth and Zimri; and Zimri as the father of Moza.
And Moza as the father of Binea; and Rephaiah as his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son.
And Azel had five sons, hose names are: Azrikam, his oldest son, and Ishmael and Sheariah and Obadiah and Hanan: these ere the sons of Azel.
No the Philistines ere fighting against Israel; and the men of Israel ent in flight before the Philistines, falling don ounded in Mount Gilboa.
And the Philistines ent hard after Saul and his sons, and put to death Jonathan and Abinadab and Malchi-shua, the sons of Saul.
And the fight as going against Saul, and the archers came across him, and he as ounded by the archers.

Then Saul said to the servant ho had the care of his arms, Take your sord and put it through me, before these men ithout circumcision come and make sport of me. But his servant, full of fear, ould not do so. Then Saul took out his sord, falling on it himself.
And hen his servant sa that Saul as dead, he did the same, and came to his death.
So death overtook Saul and his three sons; all his family came to an end together.

And hen all the men of Israel ho ere in the valley sa that the men of Israel had gone in flight and that Saul and his sons ere dead, they ent in flight aay from their tons; and the Philistines came and took them for themselves.
No the day after, hen the Philistines came to take their goods from the dead, they sa Saul and his sons dead in Mount Gilboa.
And they took everything off him, and took his head and his ar-dress, and sent ord into the land of the Philistines round about to give the nes to their gods and to the people.
And they put his ar-dress in the house of their gods, and put up his head in the house of Dagon.
And hen the nes came to Jabesh-gilead of hat the Philistines had done to Saul,
All the fighting-men came up and took aay Saul’s body and the bodies of his sons, and took them to Jabesh, and put their bones to rest under the oak-tree in Jabesh, and took no food for seven days.
So death came to Saul because of the sin hich he did against the Lord, that is, because of the ord of the Lord hich he kept not; and because he ent for directions to one ho had an evil spirit,
And not to the Lord: for this reason, he put him to death and gave the kingdom to David, the son of Jesse.
Then all Israel came together to David at Hebron, and said, Truly, e are your bone and your flesh.
In the past, hen Saul as king, it as you ho ent at the head of Israel hen they ent out or came in; and the Lord your God said to you, You are to be the keeper of my people Israel, and their ruler.

So all the responsible men of Israel came to the king at Hebron; and David made an agreement ith them in Hebron before the Lord; and they put the holy oil on David and made him king over Israel, as the Lord had said by Samuel.
Then David and all Israel ent to Jerusalem ( hich is Jebus); and the Jebusites, the people of the land, ere there.
And the people of Jebus said to David, You ill not come in here. But still, David took the strong place of Zion, hich is the ton of David.
And David said, The first to overcome the Jebusites ill be chief and captain. And Joab, the son of Zeruiah, ent up first, and became chief.
And David took the strong toer for his living-place, so it as named the ton of David.
And he took in hand the building of the ton all round, starting from the Millo; and Joab put the rest of the ton in order.
And David became greater and greater in poer, because the Lord of armies as ith him.
No these are the chief of David’s men of ar ho ere his strong supporters in the kingdom, and, ith all Israel, made him king, as the Lord had said about Israel.
This is the list of David’s men of ar: Ishbaal, the son of a Hachmonite, the chief of the three: he put to death three hundred at one time ith his spear.
And after him as Eleazar, the son of Dodo the Ahohite, ho as one of the three great fighters.
He as ith David at Pas-dammim, here the Philistines had come together for the fight, near a bit of land full of barley; and the people ent in flight before the Philistines.
And he took up his position in the middle of the bit of land, and kept back their attack, and overcame the Philistines; and the Lord gave a great salvation.
And three of the thirty ent don to David, to the rock, into the strong place of Adullam; and the army of the Philistines had taken up their position in the valley of Rephaim.
At that time David had taken cover in the strong place, and an armed force of the Philistines as in Beth-lehem.
And David, moved by a strong desire, said, If only someone ould give me a drink of the ater from the ater-hole of Beth-lehem by the dooray into the ton!

So the three, forcing a ay through the Philistine army, got ater from the ater-hole of Beth-lehem, by the dooray into the ton, and took it back to David; but David ould not take it, but made an offering of it, draining it out to the Lord,

Saying, By my God, far be it from me to do this! Ho may I take as drink the life-blood of these men ho have put their lives in danger? so he did not take it. These things did the three great men of ar.
And Abishai, the brother of Joab, as chief of the thirty, for he put to death three hundred ith his spear, but he had not a name among the three.
Of the thirty, he as the noblest, and as made their captain, but he as not equal to the first three.

Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada, a fighting-man of Kabzeel, had done great acts; he put to death to young lions going into their secret place; and he ent don into a hole and put a lion to death in time of sno.

And he made an attack on an Egyptian, a very tall man about five cubits high, armed ith a spear like a cloth-orker’s rod; he ent don to him ith a stick, and pulling his spear out of the hand of the Egyptian, put him to death ith that same spear.
These ere the acts of Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada, ho had a great name among the thirty men of ar.
He as honoured over the thirty, but he as not equal to the first three: and David put him over his servants.
And these ere the great men of ar: Asahel, the brother of Joab, Elhanan, the son of Dodo of Beth-lehem,

For I have taken this house for myself and made it holy, so that my name may be there for ever; and my eyes and my heart ill be there at all times.
And as for you, if you ill go on your ay before me as David your father did, doing hatever I have given you orders to do and keeping my las and my decisions:
Then I ill make strong the seat of your kingdom, as I gave my ord to David your father, saying, You ill never be ithout a man to be ruler in Israel.
But if you are turned aay from me, and do not keep my orders and my las hich I have put before you, but go and make yourselves servants to other gods, giving them orship:

Then I ill have this people uprooted out of my land hich I have given them; and this house, hich I have made holy for my name, I ill put aay from before my eyes, and make it an example and a ord of shame among all peoples.
And this house ill become a mass of broken alls, and everyone ho goes by ill be overcome ith onder, and ill say, Why has the Lord done so to this land and to this house?

And their anser ill be, Because they ere turned aay from the Lord, the God of their fathers, ho took them out of the land of Egypt, and took for themselves other gods and gave them orship and became their servants: that is hy he has sent all this evil on them.
No at the end of tenty years, in hich time Solomon had put up the house of the Lord and a house for himself,
He took in hand the building up of the tons hich Huram had given him, causing the children of Israel to make living-places for themselves there.
And Solomon ent to Hamath-zobah and overcame it.
And he put up the buildings of Tadmor in the aste land, and of all the store-tons in Hamath;
And of Beth-horon the higher and the loer, alled tons ith alls and doorays and locks;

And of Baalath, and all the store-tons hich Solomon had, and the tons here he kept his ar-carriages and his horse men, and everything hich it as his pleasure to put up in Jerusalem and in Lebanon and in all the land under his rule.
As for all the rest of the Hittites and the Amorites and the Perizzites and the Hivites and the Jebusites, ho ere not of Israel:
Their men ho ere still living in the land, and hom the children of Israel had not put an end to, these Solomon put to forced ork, as is done to this day;
But Solomon did not make use of the children of Israel as servants for his ork; they ere men of ar, his chiefs and his captains, and captains of his ar-carriages and his horsemen.
No these ere the chief men in authority hom King Solomon had: to hundred and fifty of them, in authority over the people.

Then Solomon made Pharaoh’s daughter come up from the ton of David to the house hich he had made for her; for he said, I ill not have my ife living in the house of David, king of Israel, because those places here the ark of the Lord has come are holy.
Then Solomon made burned offerings to the Lord on the altar of the Lord hich he had put up in front of the covered ay,

Offering every day hat had been ordered by Moses, on the Sabbaths and at the ne moon and at the regular feasts three times a year, that is at the feast of unleavened bread, the feast of eeks, and the feast of tents.

And he gave the divisions of the priests their places for their ork, as ordered by his father David, and to the Levites he gave their ork of praise and aiting on the priests, to do hat as needed day by day; and he gave the door-keepers their places in turn at every door; for so David, the man of God, had given orders.
All the orders given by the king to the priests and Levites, in connection ith any business or stores, ere done ith care.
And all the ork of Solomon as complete, from the day hen he put the base of the Lord’s house in position, till Solomon had come to the end of building the Lord’s house.

And Huram sent him, by his servants, ships and experienced seamen, ho ent ith the servants of Solomon to Ophir and came back ith four hundred and fifty talents of gold, hich they took to King Solomon.

No the queen of Sheba, hearing great things of Solomon, came to Jerusalem to put his isdom to the test ith hard questions; and ith her came a very great train, and camels eighted don ith spices, and great stores of gold and jeels: and hen she came to Solomon she had talk ith him of everything in her mind.

And hen the queen of Sheba had seen the isdom of Solomon, and the house hich he had made,

And the food at his table, and all his servants seated there, and those ho ere aiting on him in their places, and their robes, and his ine-servants and their robes, and the burned offerings hich he made in the house of the Lord, there as no more spirit in her.
And she said to the king, The account hich as given to me in my country of your acts and your isdom as true.
But I had no faith in hat as said about you, till I came and sa for myself; and truly, ord as not given me of half your great isdom; you are much greater than they said.
Happy are your ives and happy these your servants hose place is ever before you, hearing your ords of isdom.

Praise be to the Lord your God hose pleasure it as to put you on the seat of his kingdom to be king for the Lord your God: because, in his love for Israel, it as the purpose of your God to make them strong for ever, he made you king over them, to be their judge in righteousness.
And she gave the king a hundred and tenty talents of gold, and a great store of spices and jeels: never had such spices been seen as the queen of Sheba gave to Solomon.
And the servants of Huram and the servants of Solomon, in addition to gold from Ophir, came back ith sandal-ood and jeels.
And ith the sandal-ood the king made steps for the house of the Lord and for the king’s house, and instruments of music for the makers of melody; never before had such been seen in the land of Judah.
And King Solomon gave the queen of Sheba all her desire, hatever she made request for, in addition to hat she had taken to the king. So she ent back to her country ith her servants.
No the eight of gold hich came to Solomon in one year as six hundred and sixty-six talents;
And in addition to hat he got from traders of different sorts, all the kings of Arabia and the rulers of the country gave gold and silver to Solomon.
And King Solomon made to hundred body-covers of hammered gold, every one having six hundred shekels of gold in it.
And he made three hundred smaller body-covers of hammered gold, using three hundred shekels of gold for every cover, and the king put them in the house of the Woods of Lebanon.
Then the king made a great ivory seat, plated ith the best gold.
There ere six steps up to it, and a foot-rest of gold fixed to it, and arms on the to sides of the seat, ith to lions at the side of the arms.
And telve lions ere placed on one side and on the other side on the six steps: there as nothing like it in any kingdom.
All King Solomon’s drinking-vessels ere of gold, and all the vessels of the house of the Woods of Lebanon ere of the best gold: no one gave a thought to silver in the days of Solomon.
For the king had Tarshish-ships sailing ith the servants of Huram: once every three years the Tarshish-ships came back ith gold and silver, ivory and monkeys and peacocks.
And King Solomon as greater than all the kings of the earth in ealth and in isdom.
And all the kings of the earth came to see Solomon and to give ear to his isdom, hich God had put into his heart.
And everyone took ith him an offering, vessels of silver and vessels of gold, and robes, and coats of metal, and spices, and horses and beasts for transport, regularly year by year.
Solomon had four thousand buildings for his horses and his ar-carriages, and telve thousand horsemen hom he kept, some in the carriage-tons and some ith the king in Jerusalem.
And he as ruler over all the kings from the River to the land of the Philistines, as far as the limit of Egypt.
The king made silver as common as stones in Jerusalem and cedars like the sycamore-trees of the lolands in number.
They got horses for Solomon from Egypt and from every land.

No the rest of the acts of Solomon, first and last, are they not recorded in the history of Nathan the prophet, and in the ords of Ahijah the prophet of Shiloh, and in the visions of Iddo the seer about Jeroboam, the son of Nebat?
Solomon as king over Israel in Jerusalem for forty years.
And Solomon ent to rest ith his fathers, and as put into the earth in the ton of David his father; and Rehoboam his son became king in his place.
And Rehoboam ent to Shechem, here all Israel had come together to make him king.
And hen Jeroboam, the son of Nebat, had nes of it, ( for he as in Egypt here he had gone in flight from King Solomon,) he came back from Egypt.
And they sent for him; and Jeroboam and all Israel came to Rehoboam and said,
Your father put a hard yoke on us: if you ill make the conditions under hich your father kept us don less cruel, and the eight of the yoke he put on us less hard, then e ill be your servants.
And he said to them, Come to me again after three days. So the people ent aay.
Then King Rehoboam took the opinion of the old men ho had been ith Solomon his father hen he as living, and said, In your opinion, hat anser am I to give to this people?
And they said to him, If you are kind to this people, pleasing them and saying good ords to them, then they ill be your servants for ever.
But he gave no attention to the opinion of the old men, but ent to the young men of his generation ho ere aiting before him.
And he said to them, What is your opinion? What anser are e to give to this people ho have said to me, Make less the eight of the yoke hich your father put on us?

And the young men of his generation said to him, This is the anser to give to the people ho came to you saying, Your father put a hard yoke on us, but ill you make it less; say to them, My little finger is thicker than my father’s body;
If my father put a hard yoke on you, I ill make it harder: my father gave you punishment ith hips, but I ill give you blos ith snakes.
So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam on the third day, as the king had given orders, saying, Come to me again on the third day.
And the king gave them a rough anser. So King Rehoboam gave no attention to the suggestion of the old men,
But gave them the anser put forard by the young men, saying, My father made your yoke hard, but I ill make it harder; my father gave you punishment ith hips, but I ill give it ith snakes.

So the king did not give ear to the people; for this came about by the purpose of God, so that the Lord might give effect to his ord hich he had said by Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam, the son of Nebat.

And hen all Israel sa that the king ould give no attention to them, the people in anser said to the king, What part have e in David? hat is our heritage in the son of Jesse? every man to your tents, O Israel; no see to your house, David. So all Israel ent to their tents.
But Rehoboam as still king over those of the children of Israel ho ere living in the tons of Judah.
Then Rehoboam sent Adoniram, the overseer of the forced ork; and he as stoned to death by all Israel. And King Rehoboam ent quickly and got into his carriage to go in flight to Jerusalem.
So Israel as turned aay from the family of David to this day.

And Rehoboam came to Jerusalem, and got together the men of Judah and Benjamin, a hundred and eighty thousand of his best fighting-men, to make ar against Israel and get the kingdom back for Rehoboam.
But the ord of the Lord came to Shemaiah, the man of God, saying,
Say to Rehoboam, the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all Israel in Judah and Benjamin,

The Lord has said, You are not to go to ar against your brothers: let every man go back to his house, for this thing is my purpose. So they gave ear to the ords of the Lord and ere turned back from fighting against Jeroboam.
No Rehoboam kept in Jerusalem, building alled tons in Judah.
He as the builder of Beth-lehem and Etam and Tekoa
And Beth-zur and Soco and Adullam
And Gath and Mareshah and Ziph
And Adoraim and Lachish and Azekah
And Zorah and Aijalon and Hebron, alled tons in Judah and Benjamin.
And he made the alled tons strong, and he put captains in them and stores of food, oil, and ine.
And in every ton he put stores of body-covers and spears, and made them very strong. And Judah and Benjamin ere his.
And the priests and Levites ho ere in all Israel came together to him from every part of their country.
For the Levites gave up their living-places and their property, and came to Judah and Jerusalem; for Jeroboam and his sons had sent them aay, not letting them be priests to the Lord;
And he himself made priests for the high places, and for the images of he-goats and oxen hich he had made.
And after them, from all the tribes of Israel, all those hose hearts ere fixed and true to the Lord, the God of Israel, came to Jerusalem to make offerings to the Lord, the God of their fathers.
So they ent on increasing the poer of the kingdom of Judah, and made Rehoboam, the son of Solomon, strong for three years; and for three years they ent in the ays of David and Solomon.
And Rehoboam took as his ife Mahalath, the daughter of Jerimoth, the son of David and of Abihail, the daughter of Eliab, the son of Jesse;
And she had sons by him, Jeush, Shemariah, and Zaham.
And after her he took Maacah, the daughter of Absalom; and she had Abijah and Attai and Ziza and Shelomith by him.

Maacah, the daughter of Absalom, as dearer to Rehoboam than all his ives and his servant-ives: ( for he had eighteen ives and sixty servant-ives, and as the father of tenty-eight sons and sixty daughters.)
Rehoboam made Abijah, the son of Maacah, chief and ruler among his brothers, for it as his purpose to make him king.
And in his isdom he had his sons stationed in every alled ton through all the lands of Judah and Benjamin; and he gave them a great store of food, and took ives for them.
No hen Rehoboam’s position as king had been made certain, and he as strong, he gave up the la of the Lord, and all Israel ith him.
No in the fifth year of King Rehoboam, Shishak, king of Egypt, came up against Jerusalem, because of their sin against the Lord,
With telve hundred ar-carriages and sixty thousand horsemen: and the people ho came ith him out of Egypt ere more than might be numbered: Lubim and Sukkiim and Ethiopians.
And he took the alled tons of Judah, and came as far as Jerusalem.

No Shemaiah the prophet came to Rehoboam and the chiefs of Judah, ho had come together in Jerusalem because of Shishak, and said to them, The Lord has said, Because you have given me up, I have given you up into the hands of Shishak.
Then the chiefs of Israel and the king made themselves lo and said, The Lord is upright.

And the Lord, seeing that they had made themselves lo, said to Shemaiah, They have made themselves lo: I ill not send destruction on them, but in a short time I ill give them salvation, and ill not let loose my rath on Jerusalem by the hand of Shishak.
But still they ill become his servants, so that they may see ho different my yoke is from the yoke of the kingdoms of the lands.

So Shishak, king of Egypt, came up against Jerusalem and took aay all the stored ealth of the house of the Lord and the king’s house: he took everything aay, and ith the rest the gold body-covers hich Solomon had made.

And henever the king ent into the house of the Lord, the armed men ent ith him taking the body-covers, and then took them back to their room.
And hen he made himself lo, the rath of the Lord as turned back from him, and complete destruction did not come on him, for there as still some good in Judah.

So King Rehoboam made himself strong in Jerusalem and as ruling there. Rehoboam as forty-one years old hen he became king, and he as ruling for seventeen years in Jerusalem, the ton hich the Lord had made his out of all the tribes of Israel, to put his name there; and his mother’s name as Naamah, an Ammonite oman.
And he did evil because his heart as not true to the Lord.
No the acts of Rehoboam, first and last, are they not recorded in the ords of Shemaiah the prophet and Iddo the seer? And there ere ars beteen Rehoboam and Jeroboam all their days.
And Rehoboam ent to rest ith his fathers, and as put into the earth in the ton of David; and Abijah his son became king in his place.
In the eighteenth year of King Jeroboam, Abijah became king over Judah.
He as king in Jerusalem for three years; his mother’s name as Maacah, the daughter of Uriel of Gibeah. And there as ar beteen Abijah and Jeroboam.
And Abijah ent out to the fight ith an army of men of ar, four hundred thousand of his best men; and Jeroboam put his forces in line against him, eight hundred thousand of his best men of ar.
And Abijah took up his position on Mount Zemaraim, in the hill-country of Ephraim, and said, Give ear to me, O Jeroboam and all Israel:
Is it not clear to you that the Lord, the God of Israel, gave the rule over Israel to David and to his sons for ever, by an agreement made ith salt?
But Jeroboam, the son of Nebat, the servant of Solomon, the son of David, took up arms against his lord.
And certain foolish and good-for-nothing men ere joined ith him, and made themselves strong against Rehoboam, the son of Solomon, hen he as young and untested and not able to keep them back.

And no it is your purpose to put yourselves against the authority hich the Lord has put into the hands of the sons of David, and you are a very great number, and you have ith you the gold oxen hich Jeroboam made to be your gods.

And after driving out the priests of the Lord, the sons of Aaron and the Levites, have you not made priests for yourselves as the people of other lands do? so that anyone ho comes to make himself priest by offering an ox or seven sheep, may be a priest of those ho are no gods.
But as for us, the Lord is our God, and e have not been turned aay from him; e have priests ho do the ork of the Lord, even the sons of Aaron and the Levites in their places;

By hom burned offerings and perfumes are sent up in smoke before the Lord every morning and every evening; and they put out the holy bread on its table and the gold support for the lights ith its lights burning every evening; for e keep the orders given to us by the Lord our God, but you have gone aay from him.
And no God is ith us at our head, and his priests ith their loud horns sounding against you. O children of Israel, do not make ar on the Lord, the God of your fathers, for it ill not go ell for you.
But Jeroboam had put some of his men to make a surprise attack on them from the back, so some ere facing Judah and others ere stationed secretly at their back.
And Judah, turning their faces, sa that they ere being attacked in front and at the back; and they gave a cry for help to the Lord, hile the priests ere sounding their horns.
And the men of Judah gave a loud cry; and at their cry, God put fear into Jeroboam and all Israel before Abijah and Judah.
And the children of Israel ent in flight before Judah, and God gave them up into their hands.
And Abijah and his people put them to death ith great destruction: five hundred thousand of the best of Israel ere put to the sord.
So at that time the children of Israel ere overcome, and the children of Judah got the better of them, because they put their faith in the Lord, the God of their fathers.
And Abijah ent after Jeroboam and took some of his tons, Beth-el ith its small tons and Jeshanah ith its small tons and Ephron ith its small tons.
And Jeroboam did not get back his poer again in the life-time of Abijah; and the Lord sent death on him.
But Abijah became great, and had fourteen ives, and became the father of tenty-to sons and sixteen daughters.
And the rest of the acts of Abijah, and his ays and his sayings, are recorded in the account of the prophet Iddo.
So Abijah ent to rest ith his fathers, and they put him into the earth in the ton of David, and Asa his son became king in his place; in his time the land as quiet for ten years.
And Asa did hat as good and right in the eyes of the Lord his God;
For he took aay the altars of strange gods and the high places, and had the upright stones broken and the ood pillars cut don;

He said to Judah, Let us make these tons, building alls round them ith toers and doors and locks. The land is still ours, because e have been true to the Lord our God; e have been true to him and he has given us rest on every side. So they ent on building and all ent ell for them.

And Asa made prayer to the Lord his God and said, Lord, you only are able to give help against the strong to him ho has no strength; come to our help, O Lord our God, for our hope is in you, and in your name e have come out against this great army. O Lord, you are our God; let not man’s poer be greater than yours.

And Asa and the people ho ere ith him ent after them as far as Gerar; and so great as the destruction among the Ethiopians that they ere not able to get their army together again, for they ere broken before the Lord and before his army; and they took aay a great amount of their goods.

And they made an attack on the tents of the oners of the cattle, and took aay great numbers of sheep and camels and ent back to Jerusalem.
And the spirit of God came on Azariah, the son of Oded;

And he came face to face ith Asa and said to him, Give ear to me, Asa and all Judah and Benjamin: the Lord is ith you hile you are ith him; if your heart’s desire is for him, he ill be near you, but if you give him up, he ill give you up.
No for a long time Israel has been ithout the true God, and ithout a teaching priest and ithout the la;
But hen in their trouble they ere turned to the Lord, the God of Israel, searching after him, he let their search be rearded.

And they ere broken by divisions, nation against nation and ton against ton, because God sent all sorts of trouble on them.
But be you strong and let not your hands be feeble, for your ork ill be rearded.

And Asa, hearing these ords of Azariah, the son of Oded the prophet, took heart and put aay all the disgusting things out of all the land of Judah and Benjamin, and out of the tons hich he had taken from the hill-country of Ephraim; and he made ne again the altar of the Lord in front of the covered ay of the Lord’s house.

And he got together all Judah and Benjamin and those of Ephraim and Manasseh and Simeon ho ere living ith them; for numbers of them came to him out of Israel hen they sa that the Lord his God as ith him.

And they made an agreement to be true to the Lord, the God of their fathers, ith all their heart and all their soul;
And that anyone, small or great, man or oman, ho as not true to the Lord, the God of Israel, ould be put to death.
And they made an oath to the Lord, ith a loud voice, sounding ind-instruments and horns.
And all Judah as glad because of the oath, for they had taken it ith all their heart, turning to the Lord ith all their desire; and he as ith them and gave them rest on every side.
And Asa ould not let Maacah, his mother, be queen, because she had made a disgusting image for Asherah; and Asa had her image cut don and broken up and burned by the stream Kidron.
But the high places ere not taken aay out of Israel; but still the heart of Asa as true to the Lord all his life.
He took into the house of God all the things hich his father had made holy and those hich he himself had made holy, silver and gold and vessels.
And there as no more ar till the thirty-fifth year of the rule of Asa.
In the thirty-sixth year of the rule of Asa, Baasha, king of Israel, ent up against Judah, building Ramah so that no one as able to go out or in to Asa, king of Judah.
Then Asa took silver and gold out of the stores of the Lord’s house and of the king’s store-house, and sent to Ben-hadad, king of Aram, at Damascus, saying,

Let there be an agreement beteen me and you as there as beteen my father and your father: see, I have sent you silver and gold; go and put an end to your agreement ith Baasha, king of Israel, so that he may give up attacking me.
And Ben-hadad did as King Asa said, and sent the captains of his armies against the tons of Israel, attacking Ijon and Dan and Abel-maim, and all the store-tons of Naphtali.
Then Baasha, hearing of it, put a stop to the building of Ramah, and let his ork come to an end.
Then King Asa, ith all Judah, took aay the stones and ood ith hich Baasha as building Ramah, and he made use of them for building Geba and Mizpah.

At that time Hanani the seer came to Asa, king of Judah, and said to him, Because you have put your faith in the king of Aram and not in the Lord your God, the army of the king of Aram has got aay out of your hands.
Were not the Ethiopians and the Lubim a very great army, ith ar-carriages and horsemen more than might be numbered? but because your faith as in the Lord, he gave them up into your hands.

For the eyes of the Lord go this ay and that, through all the earth, letting it be seen that he is the strong support of those hose hearts are true to him. In this you have done foolishly, for from no you ill have ars.
Then Asa as angry ith the seer, and put him in prison, burning ith rath against him because of this thing. And at the same time Asa as cruel to some of the people.
No the acts of Asa, first and last, are recorded in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.
In the thirty-ninth year of his rule, Asa had a very bad disease of the feet; but he did not go to the Lord for help in his disease, but to medical men.
So Asa ent to rest ith his fathers, and death came to him in the forty-first year of his rule.

And they put him into the resting-place hich he had made for himself in the ton of David, in a bed full of seet perfumes of all sorts of spices, made by the perfumer’s art, and they made a great burning for him.
And Jehoshaphat his son became king in his place, and made himself strong against Israel.
He put forces in all the alled tons of Judah, and responsible chiefs in the land of Judah and in the tons of Ephraim, hich Asa his father had taken.
And the Lord as ith Jehoshaphat, because he ent in the early ays of his father, not turning to the Baals,
But turning to the God of his father and keeping his las, and not doing as Israel did.
So the Lord made his kingdom strong; and all Judah gave offerings to Jehoshaphat, and he had great ealth and honour.
His heart as lifted up in the ays of the Lord; and he ent so far as to take aay the high places and the ood pillars out of Judah.
In the third year of his rule he sent Benhail and Obadiah and Zechariah and Nethanel and Micaiah, his captains, as teachers into the tons of Judah;
And ith them, Shemaiah and Nethaniah and Zebadiah and Asahel and Shemiramoth and Jehonathan and Adonijah and Tobijah and Tob-adonijah, the Levites; and Elishama and Jehoram the priests.
And they gave teaching in Judah and had the book of the la of the Lord ith them; they ent through all the tons of Judah teaching the people.
And the fear of the Lord as on all the kingdoms of the lands round Judah, so that they made no ars against Jehoshaphat.

And some of the Philistines took offerings to Jehoshaphat, and made him payments of silver; and the Arabians gave him flocks, seven thousand, seven hundred sheep, and seven thousand, seven hundred he-goats.
Jehoshaphat became greater and greater, and made strong toers and store-tons in Judah.
He had much property in the tons of Judah; he had forces of armed men, great and strong, in Jerusalem.
This is the number of them, listed by their families, the captains of thousands of Judah: Adnah, the captain, and ith him three hundred thousand men of ar;
Second to him Jehohanan, the captain, and ith him to hundred and eighty thousand;
After him Amasiah, the son of Zichri, ho freely gave himself to the Lord, and ith him to hundred thousand men of ar;
And the captains of Benjamin: Eliada, a great man of ar, and ith him to hundred thousand armed ith bos and body-covers;
And after him Jehozabad, and ith him a hundred and eighty thousand trained for ar.

Then the Levites took their places; Mahath, the son of Amasai, and Joel, the son of Azariah, among the Kohathites; and of the sons of Merari, Kish, the son of Abdi, and Azariah, the son of Jehallelel; and of the Gershonites, Joah, the son of Zimmah, and Eden, the son of Joah;

After this, Sennacherib, king of Assyria, sent his servants to Jerusalem ( at that time he as stationed ith all his army in front of Lachish), to say to Hezekiah and all the men of Judah in Jerusalem,

And of the music-makers, Eliashib; and of the door-keepers, Shallum and Telem and Uri.
And of Israel, the sons of Parosh, Ramiah and Izziah and Malchijah and Mijamin and Eleazar and Malchijah and Benaiah.
And of the sons of Elam, Mattaniah, Zechariah, and Jehiel and Abdi and Jeremoth and Elijah.
And of the sons of Zattu, Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, and Jeremoth and Zabad and Aziza.
And of the sons of Bebai, Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, Athlai.
And of the sons of Bani, Meshullam, Malluch, and Adaiah, Jashub and Sheal, Jeremoth.
And of the sons of Pahath-moab, Adna and Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezalel and Binnui and Manasseh.
And of the sons of Harim, Eliezer, Isshijah, Malchijah, Shemaiah, Shimeon,
Benjamin, Malluch, Shemariah.
Of the sons of Hashum, Mattenai, Mattattah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, Shimei.

Benaiah, Bedeiah, Cheluhi,
Vaniah, Meremoth, Eliashib,

And Bani and Binnui, Shimei;
And Shelemiah and Nathan and Adaiah,
Machnadebai, Shashai, Sharai,
