So this is hat the Lord has said about the prophets ho make use of my name, though I sent them not, and say, The sord and need of food ill not be in this land: the sord and need of food ill put an end to those prophets.

And the people to hom they are prophets ill be pushed out dead into the streets of Jerusalem, because there is no food, and because of the sord; and they ill have no one to put their bodies into the earth, them or their ives or their sons or their daughters: for I ill let loose their evil-doing on them.

And you are to say this ord to them, Let my eyes be streaming ith ater night and day, and let it not be stopped; for the virgin daughter of my people is ounded ith a great ound, ith a very bitter blo.

If I go out into the open country, there are those put to death by the sord! and if I go into the ton, there are those ho are diseased from need of food! for the prophet and the priest go about in the land and have no knoledge.

Have you completely given up Judah? is your soul turned in disgust from Zion? hy have you given us blos from hich there is no one to make us ell? e ere looking for peace, but no good came; and for a time of ell-being, but there as only a great fear.
We are conscious, O Lord, of our sin and of the rongdoing of our fathers: e have done evil against you.
Do not be turned from us in disgust, because of your name; do not put shame on the seat of your glory: keep us in mind, let not your agreement ith us be broken.

Are any of the false gods of the nations able to make rain come? are the heavens able to give shoers? are you not he, O Lord our God? so e ill go on aiting for you, for you have done all these things.
Then the Lord said to me, Even if Moses and Samuel came before me, I ould have no desire for this people: send them aay from before me, and let them go.

And it ill be, hen they say to you, Where are e to go? then you are to say to them, The Lord has said, Such as are for death, to death; and such as are for the sord, to the sord; and such as are to be in need of food, to need of food; and such as are to be taken aay prisoners, to be taken aay.

And I ill put over them four divisions, says the Lord: the sord causing death, dogs pulling the dead bodies about, and the birds of heaven, and the beasts of the earth to take their bodies for food and put an end to them.
And I ill make them a cause of fear to all the kingdoms of the earth, because of Manasseh, the son of Hezekiah, king of Judah, and hat he did in Jerusalem.
For ho ill have pity on you, O Jerusalem? and ho ill have sorro for you? or ho ill go out of his ay to see ho you are?
You have given me up, says the Lord, you have gone back: so my hand is stretched out against you for your destruction; I am tired of changing my purpose.
And I have sent a cleaning ind on them in the public places of the land; I have taken their children from them; I have given my people to destruction; they have not been turned from their ays.

I have let their idos be increased in number more than the sand of the seas: I have sent against them, against the mother and the young men, one ho makes aste in the heat of the day, causing pain and fears to come on her suddenly.

The mother of seven is ithout strength; her spirit is gone from her, her sun has gone don hile it is still day: she has been shamed and overcome: and the rest of them I ill give up to the sord before their haters, says the Lord.

Sorro is mine, my mother, because you have given birth to me, a cause of fighting and argument in all the earth! I have not made men my creditors and I am not in debt to any, but every one of them is cursing me.
Is it possible for iron to be broken; even iron from the north, and brass?
I ill give your ealth and your stores to your attackers, ithout a price, because of all your sins, even in every part of your land.
They ill go aay ith your haters into a land hich is strange to you: for my rath is on fire ith a flame hich ill be burning on you.

O Lord, you have knoledge: keep me in mind and come to my help, and give their right reard to those ho are attacking me; take me not aay, for you are slo to be angry: see ho I have undergone shame because of you from all those ho make little of your ord;
But to me your ord is a joy, making my heart glad; for I am named by your name, O Lord God of armies.
I did not take my seat among the band of those ho are glad, and I had no joy; I kept by myself because of your hand; for you have made me full of rath.
Why is my pain unending and my ound ithout hope of being made ell? Sorro is mine, for you are to me as a stream offering false hope and as aters hich are not certain.

For this cause the Lord has said, If you ill come back, then I ill again let you take your place before me; and if you give out hat is of value and not that hich has no value, you ill be as my mouth: let them come back to you, but do not go back to them.
And I ill make you a strong all of brass to this people; they ill be fighting against you, but they ill not overcome you: for I am ith you to keep you safe, says the Lord.
I ill keep you safe from the hands of the evil-doers, and I ill give you salvation from the hands of the cruel ones.
Then again the ord of the Lord came to me, saying,
You are not to take a ife for yourself or have sons or daughters in this place.

For this is hat the Lord has said about the sons and daughters ho come to birth in this place, and about their mothers ho have given them birth, and about their fathers ho have given life to them in this land:

Death from evil diseases ill overtake them; there ill be no eeping for them and their bodies ill not be put to rest; they ill be like aste on the face of the earth: the sord and need of food ill put an end to them; their dead bodies ill be meat for the birds of heaven and for the beasts of the earth.

For this is hat the Lord has said: Do not go into the house of sorro, do not go to make eeping or songs of grief for them: for I have taken aay my peace from this people, says the Lord, even mercy and pity.
Death ill overtake great as ell as small in the land: their bodies ill not be put in a resting-place, and no one ill be eeping for them or ounding themselves or cutting off their hair for them:
No one ill make a feast for them in sorro, to give them comfort for the dead, or put to their lips the cup of comfort on account of their father or their mother.
And you are not to go into the house of feasting, or be seated ith them to take food or drink.

For the Lord of armies, the God of Israel, has said, See, before your eyes and in your days I ill put an end in this place to the laughing voices and the voice of joy; to the voice of the nely-married man and the voice of the bride.

And it ill be, that hen you say all these ords to the people, then they ill say to you, Why has the Lord done all this evil against us? hat is our rongdoing and hat is our sin hich e have done against the Lord our God?

Then you ill say to them, Because your fathers have given me up, says the Lord, and have gone after other gods and become their servants and their orshippers, and have given me up and have not kept my la;
And you have done orse evil than your fathers; for see, every one of you is guided by the pride of his evil heart, so as not to give ear to me:

For this reason I ill send you aay out of this land into a land hich is strange to you, to you and to your fathers; there you ill be the servants of other gods day and night, and you ill have no mercy from me.
For this cause, see, the days are coming, says the Lord, hen it ill no longer be said, By the living Lord, ho took the children of Israel up out of the land of Egypt.

But, By the living Lord, ho took the children of Israel up out of the land of the north, and from all the countries here he had sent them: and I ill take them back again to their land hich I gave to their fathers.

See, I ill send for great numbers of fishermen, says the Lord, and they ill take them like fish in a net; and after that, I ill send for numbers of bomen, and they ill go after them, driving them from every mountain and from every hill, and out of the holes of the rocks.
For my eyes are on all their ays: there is no cover for them from my face, and their evil-doing is not kept secret from my eyes.
And I ill give them the reard of their evil-doing and their sin tice over; because they have made my land unclean, and have made my heritage full of the bodies of their unholy and disgusting things.

O Lord, my strength and my strong toer, my safe place in the day of trouble, the nations ill come to you from the ends of the earth, and say, The heritage of our fathers is nothing but deceit, even false things in hich there is no profit.
Will a man make for himself gods hich are no gods?
For this reason, truly, I ill make them see, this once I ill give them knoledge of my hand and my poer; and they ill be certain that my name is the Lord.
The sin of Judah is recorded ith a pen of iron, and ith the sharp point of a jeel it is cut on their hearts of stone, and on the horns of their altars for a sign to them:
Their altars and their ood pillars under every branching tree, on the high hills and the mountains in the field.
I ill give your ealth and all your stores to be taken aay in ar ithout a price, because of your sins in every part of your land.

And your hand ill have to let go your heritage hich I gave you; and I ill make you a servant to your haters in a land hich is strange to you: for you have put my rath on fire ith a flame hich ill go on burning for ever.
This is hat the Lord has said: Cursed is the man ho puts his faith in man, and makes flesh his arm, and hose heart is turned aay from the Lord.
For he ill be like the brushood in the upland, and ill not see hen good comes; but his living-place ill be in the dry places in the aste land, in a salt and unpeopled land.
A blessing is on the man ho puts his faith in the Lord, and hose hope the Lord is.

For he ill be like a tree planted by the aters, pushing out its roots by the stream; he ill have no fear hen the heat comes, but his leaf ill be green; in a dry year he ill have no care, and ill go on giving fruit.
The heart is a tisted thing, not to be searched out by man: ho is able to have knoledge of it?
I the Lord am the searcher of the heart, the tester of the thoughts, so that I may give to every man the reard of his ays, in keeping ith the fruit of his doings.
Like the partridge, getting eggs together but not producing young, is a man ho gets ealth but not by right; before half his days are ended, it ill go from him, and at his end he ill be foolish.
A seat of glory, placed on high from the first, is our holy place.
O Lord, the hope of Israel, all ho give you up ill be put to shame; those ho go aay from you ill be cut off from the earth, because they have given up the Lord, the fountain of living aters.
Make me ell, O Lord, and I ill be ell; be my saviour, and I ill be safe: for you are my hope.
See, they say to me, Where is the ord of the Lord? let it come no.
As for me, I have not said; Let the day of trouble come to them quickly; and I have not been hoping for the death-giving day; you have knoledge of hat came from my lips; it as open before you.
Be not a cause of fear to me: you are my safe place in the day of evil.
Let them be put to shame ho are attacking me, but let me not be shamed; let them be overcome ith fear, but let me not be overcome: send on them the day of evil, and put them to destruction tice over.
This is hat the Lord has said to me: Go and take your place in the dooray of Benjamin, here the kings of Judah come in and by hich they go out, and in all the doorays of Jerusalem;
And say to them, Give ear to the ord of the Lord, you kings of Judah, and all the people of Jerusalem ho come in by these doors:
This is hat the Lord has said: See to yourselves, that you take up no eight on the Sabbath day, or take it in through the doors of Jerusalem;
And take no eight out of your houses on the Sabbath day, or do any ork, but keep the Sabbath day holy, as I gave orders to your fathers;
But they gave no attention and ould not give ear, but they made their necks stiff so that they might not give ear and might not get teaching.
And it ill be, that if ith all care you give ear to me, says the Lord, and take no eight through the doorays of this ton on the Sabbath day, but keep the Sabbath day holy and do no ork in it;

Then through the doors of this ton there ill come kings and princes, seated on the seat of David, going in carriages and on horseback, they and their princes, and the men of Judah and the people of Jerusalem: and this ton ill keep its place for ever.

And they ill come from the tons of Judah, and from the places round about Jerusalem, and from the land of Benjamin, and from the lolands, and from the mountains, and from the South, ith burned offerings and offerings of beasts and meal offerings and perfume and offerings of praise, to the house of the Lord.

But if you do not give ear to me, to keep the Sabbath day holy, and to let no eight be lifted and taken through the doors of Jerusalem on the Sabbath day: then I ill put a fire in its doorays, burning up the great houses of Jerusalem, and it ill never be put out.
The ord hich came to Jeremiah from the Lord, saying,
Up! go don to the potter’s house, and there I ill let my ords come to your ears.
Then I ent don to the potter’s house, and he as doing his ork on the stones.
And hen the vessel, hich he as forming out of earth, got damaged in the hand of the potter, he made it again into another vessel, as it seemed good to the potter to make it.
Then the ord of the Lord came to me, saying,
O Israel, am I not able to do ith you as this potter does? says the Lord. See, like earth in the potter’s hand are you in my hands, O Israel.
Whenever I say anything about uprooting a nation or a kingdom, and smashing it and sending destruction on it;
If, in that very minute, that nation of hich I as talking is turned aay from its evil, my purpose of doing evil to them ill be changed.
And henever I say anything about building up a nation or a kingdom, and planting it;
If, in that very minute, it does evil in my eyes, going against my orders, then my good purpose, hich I said I ould do for them, ill be changed.

No, then, say to the men of Judah and to the people of Jerusalem, This is hat the Lord has said: See, I am forming an evil thing against you, and designing a design against you: let every man come back no from his evil ay, and let your ays and your doings be changed for the better.
But they ill say, There is no hope: e ill go on in our designs, and every one of us ill do hat he is moved by the pride of his evil heart to do.
So this is hat the Lord has said: Make search among the nations and see ho has had ord of such things; the virgin of Israel has done a very shocking thing.
Will the hite sno go aay from the top of Sirion? ill the cold aters floing from the mountains become dry?

For my people have put me out of their memory, burning perfumes to that hich is nothing; and because of this, I ill put a cause of falling in their ays, even in the old roads, and ill make them go on side-roads, in a ay not lifted up;
Making their land a thing of onder, causing sounds of surprise for ever; everyone ho goes by ill be overcome ith onder, shaking his head.
I ill send them in flight, as from an east ind, before the attacker; I ill let them see my back and not my face on the day of their donfall.

Then they said, Come, let us make a design against Jeremiah; for teaching ill never be cut off from the priest, or isdom from the ise, or the ord from the prophet. Come, let us make use of his ords for an attack on him, and let us give attention ith care to hat he says.
Give thought to me, O Lord, and give ear to the voice of those ho put forard a cause against me.
Is evil to be the reard of good? for they have made a deep hole for my soul. Keep in mind ho I took my place before you, to say a good ord for them so that your rath might be turned aay from them.

For this cause, let their children be ithout food, and give them over to the poer of the sord; and let their ives be ithout children and become idos; let their men be overtaken by death, and their young men be put to the sord in the fight.
Let a cry for help go up from their houses, hen you send an armed band on them suddenly: for they have made a hole in hich to take me, and have put nets for my feet secretly.

But you, Lord, have knoledge of all the designs hich they have made against my life; let not their evil-doing be covered or their sin be ashed aay from before your eyes: but let it be a cause of falling before you: so do to them in the time of your rath.
This is hat the Lord has said: Go and get for money a potter’s bottle made of earth, and take ith you some of the responsible men of the people and of the priests;
And go out to the valley of the son of Hinnom, by the ay into the door of broken pots, and there say in a loud voice the ords hich I ill give you;

Say, Give ear to the ord of the Lord, O kings of Judah and people of Jerusalem; the Lord of armies, the God of Israel, has said, See, I ill send evil on this place hich ill be bitter to the ears of anyone hearing of it.

Because they have given me up, and made this place a strange place, burning perfumes in it to other gods, of hom they and their fathers and the kings of Judah had no knoledge; and they have made this place full of the blood of those ho have done no rong;
And they have put up the high places of the Baal, burning their sons in the fire; a thing hich as not ordered by me, and it as never in my mind:
For this cause, see, a time is coming, says the Lord, hen this place ill no longer be named Topheth, or, The valley of the son of Hinnom, but, The valley of Death.

I ill make the purpose of Judah and Jerusalem come to nothing in this place; I ill have them put to the sord by their haters, and by the hands of those ho have designs on their life; and their dead bodies I ill give to be food for the birds of heaven and the beasts of the earth.
And I ill make this ton a thing of onder and a cause of surprise; everyone ho goes by ill be overcome ith onder and make sounds of surprise, because of all its troubles.

I ill make them take the flesh of their sons and the flesh of their daughters for food, they ill be making a meal of one another, because of their bitter need and the cruel grip of their haters and those ho have made designs against their life.
Then let the potter’s bottle be broken before the eyes of the men ho have gone ith you,

And say to them, This is hat the Lord of armies has said: Even so ill this people and this ton be broken by me, as a potter’s bottle is broken and may not be put together again: and the bodies of the dead ill be put in the earth in Topheth, till there is no more room.
This is hat I ill do to this place, says the Lord, and to its people, making this ton like Topheth:

And the houses of Jerusalem, and the houses of the kings of Judah, hich they have made unclean, ill be like the place of Topheth, even all the houses on hose roofs perfumes have been burned to all the army of heaven, and drink offerings drained out to other gods.
Then Jeremiah came from Topheth, here the Lord had sent him to give the prophet’s ord; and he took his place in the open square of the Lord’s house, and said to all the people,

The Lord of armies, the God of Israel, has said: See, I ill send on this ton and on all her tons all the evil hich I have said; because they made their necks stiff, so that they might not give ear to my ords.
No it came to the ears of Pashhur, the son of Immer the priest, ho as chief in authority in the house of the Lord, that Jeremiah as saying these things;
And Pashhur gave blos to Jeremiah and had his feet chained in a frameork of ood in the higher dooray of Benjamin, hich as in the house of the Lord.
Then on the day after, Pashhur let Jeremiah loose. Then Jeremiah said to him, The Lord has given you the name of Magor-missabib (Cause-of-fear-on-every-side), not Pashhur.

For the Lord has said, See, I ill make you a cause of fear to yourself and to all your friends: they ill come to their death by the sord of their haters, and your eyes ill see it: and I ill give all Judah into the hands of the king of Babylon, and he ill take them aay prisoners into Babylon and put them to the sord.

And more than this, I ill give all the ealth of this ton and all its profits and all its things of value, even all the stores of the kings of Judah ill I give into the hands of their haters, ho ill put violent hands on them and take them aay to Babylon.
And you, Pashhur, and all ho are in your house, ill go aay prisoners: you ill come to Babylon, and there your body ill be put to rest, you and all your friends, to hom you said false ords.
O Lord, you have been false to me, and I as tricked; you are stronger than I, and have overcome me: I have become a thing to be laughed at all the day, everyone makes sport of me.
For every ord I say is a cry for help; I say ith a loud voice, Violent behaviour and asting: because the ord of the Lord is made a shame to me and a cause of laughing all the day.

And if I say, I ill not keep him in mind, I ill not say another ord in his name; then it is in my heart like a burning fire shut up in my bones, and I am tired of keeping myself in, I am not able to do it.

For numbers of them say evil secretly in my hearing ( there is fear on every side): they say, Come, let us give itness against him; all my nearest friends, ho are atching for my fall, say, It may be that he ill be taken by deceit, and e ill get the better of him and give him punishment.

But the Lord is ith me as a great one, greatly to be feared: so my attackers ill have a fall, and they ill not overcome me: they ill be greatly shamed, because they have not done isely, even ith an unending shame, kept in memory for ever.
But, O Lord of armies, testing the upright and seeing the thoughts and the heart, let me see your punishment come on them; for I have put my cause before you.
Make melody to the Lord, give praise to the Lord: for he has made the soul of the poor man free from the hands of the evil-doers.
A curse on the day of my birth: let there be no blessing on the day hen my mother had me.
A curse on the man ho gave the nes to my father, saying, You have a male child; making him very glad.
May that man be like the tons overturned by the Lord ithout mercy: let a cry for help come to his ears in the morning, and the sound of ar in the middle of the day;
Because he did not put me to death before my birth took place: so my mother’s body ould have been my last resting-place, and she ould have been ith child for ever.
Why did I come from my mother’s body to see pain and sorro, so that my days might be asted ith shame?
The ord hich came to Jeremiah from the Lord, hen King Zedekiah sent to him Pashhur, the son of Malchiah, and Zephaniah, the son of Maaseiah the priest, saying,

Will you get directions from the Lord for us; for Nebuchadrezzar, king of Babylon, is making ar against us; it may be that the Lord ill do something for us like all the onders he has done, and make him go aay from us.
Then Jeremiah said to them, This is hat you are to say to Zedekiah:

The Lord God of Israel has said, See, I am turning back the instruments of ar in your hands, ith hich you are fighting against the king of Babylon and the Chaldaeans, ho are outside the alls and shutting you in; and I ill get them together inside this ton.
And I myself ill be fighting against you ith an outstretched hand and ith a strong arm, even ith angry feeling and passion and in great rath.
And I ill send a great disease on the people living in this ton, on man and on beast, causing their death.

And after that, says the Lord, I ill give up Zedekiah, king of Judah, and his servants and his people, even those in the ton ho have not come to their end from the disease and the sord and from need of food, into the hands of Nebuchadrezzar, king of Babylon, and into the hands of their haters, and into the hands of those desiring their death: he ill put them to the sord; he ill not let anyone get aay, he ill have no pity or mercy.
And to this people you are to say, The Lord has said, See, I put before you the ay of life and the ay of death.

He ho keeps in this ton ill come to his death by the sord and through need of food and through disease; but he ho goes out and gives himself up to the Chaldaeans ho are shutting you in, ill go on living, and ill keep his life safe.
For my face is turned to this ton for evil and not for good, says the Lord: it ill be given into the hands of the king of Babylon, and he ill have it burned ith fire.
About the family of the king of Judah. Give ear to the ord of the Lord;

O family of David, this is hat the Lord has said: Do hat is right in the morning, and make free from the hands of the cruel one him hose goods have been violently taken aay, or my rath ill go out like fire, burning so that no one may put it out, because of the evil of your doings.
See, I am against you, you ho are living on the rock of the valley, says the Lord; you ho say, Who ill come don against us? or ho ill get into our houses?
I ill send punishment on you in keeping ith the fruit of your doings, says the Lord: and I ill put a fire in her oodlands, burning up everything round about her.
This is hat the Lord has said: Go don to the house of the king of Judah and there give him this ord,
And say, Give ear to the ord of the Lord, O king of Judah, seated on the seat of David, you and your servants and your people ho come in by these doors.

This is hat the Lord has said: Do hat is right, judging uprightly, and make free from the hands of the cruel one him hose goods have been violently taken aay: do no rong and be not violent to the man from a strange country and the child ithout a father and the ido, and let not those ho have done no rong be put to death in this place.
For if you truly do this, then there ill come in through the doors of this house kings seated on the seat of David, going in carriages and on horseback, he and his servants and his people
But if you do not give ear to these ords, I give you my oath by myself, says the Lord, that this house ill become a aste.
For this is hat the Lord has said about the family of the king of Judah: You are Gilead to me, and the top of Lebanon: but, truly, I ill make you aste, ith tons unpeopled.
And I ill make ready those ho ill send destruction on you, everyone armed for ar: by them your best cedar-trees ill be cut don and put in the fire.
And nations from all sides ill go past this ton, and every man ill say to his neighbour, Why has the Lord done such things to this great ton?
And they ill say, Because they gave up the agreement of the Lord their God, and became orshippers and servants of other gods.
Let there be no eeping for the dead, and make no songs of grief for him: but make bitter eeping for him ho has gone aay, for he ill never come back or see again the country of his birth.
For this is hat the Lord has said about Shallum, the son of Josiah, king of Judah, ho became king in place of Josiah his father, ho ent out from this place: He ill never come back there again:
But death ill come to him in the place here they have taken him aay prisoner, and he ill never see this land again.
A curse is on him ho is building his house by rongdoing, and his rooms by doing hat is not right; ho makes use of his neighbour ithout payment, and gives him nothing for his ork;
Who says, I ill make a ide house for myself, and rooms of great size, and has indos cut out, and has it roofed ith cedar and painted ith bright red.
Are you to be a king because you make more use of cedar than your father? did not your father take food and drink and do right, judging in righteousness, and then it as ell for him?
He as judge in the cause of the poor and those in need; then it as ell. Was not this to have knoledge of me? says the Lord.
But your eyes and your heart are fixed only on profit for yourself, on causing the death of him ho has done no rong, and on violent and cruel acts.

So this is hat the Lord has said about Jehoiakim, the son of Josiah, king of Judah: They ill make no eeping for him, saying, Ah my brother! or, Ah sister! they ill make no eeping for him, saying, Ah lord! or, Ah his glory!
They ill do to him hat they do to the dead body of an ass; his body ill be pulled out and placed on the earth outside the doors of Jerusalem.
Go up to Lebanon and give a cry; let your voice be loud in Bashan, crying out from Abarim; for all your lovers have come to destruction
My ord came to you in the time of your ell-being; but you said, I ill not give ear. This has been your ay from your earliest years, you did not give attention to my voice.
All the keepers of your sheep ill be food for the ind, and your lovers ill be taken aay prisoners: truly, then you ill be shamed and unhonoured because of all your evil-doing.
O you ho are living in Lebanon, making your living-place in the cedars, ho greatly to be pitied ill you be hen pains come on you, as on a oman in childbirth!
By my life, says the Lord, even if Coniah, the son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, as the ring on my right hand, even from there I ould have you pulled off;

And I ill give you into the hands of those desiring your death, and into the hands of those hom you are fearing, even into the hands of Nebuchadrezzar, king of Babylon, and into the hands of the Chaldaeans.
I ill send you out, and your mother ho gave you birth, into another country not the land of your birth; and there death ill come to you.
But to the land on hich their soul’s desire is fixed, they ill never come back.
Is this man Coniah a broken vessel of no value? is he a vessel in hich there is no pleasure? hy are they violently sent out, he and his seed, into a land hich is strange to them?
O earth, earth, earth, give ear to the ord of the Lord!

The Lord has said, Let this man be recorded as having no children, a man ho ill not do ell in all his life: for no man of his seed ill do ell, seated on the seat of the kingdom of David and ruling again in Judah.
A curse is on the keepers ho are causing the destruction and loss of the sheep of my field, says the Lord.

So this is hat the Lord, the God of Israel, has said against the keepers ho have the care of my people: You have let my flock be broken up, driving them aay and not caring for them; see, I ill send on you the punishment for the evil of your doings, says the Lord.
And I ill get the rest of my flock together from all the countries here I have sent them, and ill make them come back again to their resting-place; and they ill have offspring and be increased.
And I ill put over them keepers ho ill take care of them: never again ill they be overcome ith fear or be troubled, and there ill not be the loss of one of them, says the Lord.
See, the days are coming, says the Lord, hen I ill give to David a true Branch, and he ill be ruling as king, acting isely, doing hat is right, and judging uprightly in the land.
In his days Judah ill have salvation and Israel ill be living ithout fear: and this is the name by hich he ill be named, The Lord is our righteousness.
And so, truly, the days are coming hen they ill say no longer, By the living Lord, ho took the children of Israel up out of the land of Egypt;

But, By the living Lord, ho took up the seed of Israel, and made them come out of the north country, and from all the countries here I had sent them; and they ill be living in the land hich is theirs.
About the prophets. My heart is broken in me, all my bones are shaking; I am like a man full of strong drink, like a man overcome by ine; because of the Lord, and because of his holy ords.

For the land is full of men ho are untrue to their ives; because of the curse the land is full of grief; the green fields of the aste land have become dry; and they are quick to do evil, their strength is for hat is not right.
For the prophet as ell as the priest is unclean; even in my house I have seen their evil-doing, says the Lord.
For this cause their steps ill be slipping on their ay: they ill be forced on into the dark and have a fall there: for I ill send evil on them in the year of their punishment, says the Lord.
And I have seen ays ithout sense in the prophets of Samaria; they became prophets of the Baal, causing my people Israel to go rong.

And in the prophets of Jerusalem I have seen a shocking thing; they are untrue to their ives, alking in deceit, and they make strong the hands of evil-doers, so that a man may not be turned back from his evil-doing: they have all become like Sodom to me, and its people like Gomorrah.

So this is hat the Lord of armies has said about the prophets: See, I ill give them a bitter plant for their food, and bitter ater for their drink: for from the prophets of Jerusalem unclean behaviour has gone out into all the land.

This is hat the Lord of armies has said: Do not give ear to the ords hich the prophets say to you: they give you teaching of no value: it is from themselves that their vision comes, and not out of the mouth of the Lord.
They keep on saying to those ho have no respect for the ord of the Lord, You ill have peace; and to everyone ho goes on his ay in the pride of his heart, they say, No evil ill come to you.
For hich of them has knoledge of the secret of the Lord, and has seen him, and given ear to his ord? hich of them has taken note of his ord and given attention to it?
See, the storm-ind of the Lord, even the heat of his rath, has gone out, a rolling storm, bursting on the heads of the evil-doers.
The rath of the Lord ill not be turned back till he has done, till he has put into effect, the purposes of his heart: in days to come you ill have full knoledge of this.
I did not send these prophets, but they ent running: I said nothing to them, but they gave out the prophet’s ord.
But if they had been in my secret, then they ould have made my people give ear to my ords, turning them from their evil ay, and from the evil of their doings.
Am I only a God ho is near, says the Lord, and not a God at a distance?
In hat secret place may a man take cover ithout my seeing him? says the Lord. Is there any place in heaven or earth here I am not? says the Lord.
My ears have been open to hat the prophets have said, ho say false ords in my name, saying, I have had a dream, I have had a dream, I have had a dream,
Is ( my ord) in the hearts of the prophets ho give out false ords, even the prophets of the deceit of their hearts?
Whose purpose is to take aay the memory of my name from my people by their dreams, of hich every man is talking to his neighbour, as their fathers gave up the memory of my name for the Baal.
If a prophet has a dream, let him give out his dream; and he ho has my ord, let him give out my ord in good faith. What has the dry stem to do ith the grain? says the Lord.
Is not my ord like fire? says the Lord; and like a hammer, smashing the rock to bits?
For this cause I am against the prophets, says the Lord, ho take my ords, every one from his neighbour.
See, I am against the prophets, says the Lord, ho let their tongues say, He has said.

See, I am against the prophets of false dreams, says the Lord, ho give them out and make my people go out of the ay by their deceit and their uncontrolled ords: but I did not send them or give them orders; and they ill be of no profit to this people, says the Lord.

And if this people, or the prophet, or a priest, questioning you, says, What ord of eight is there from the Lord? then you are to say to them, You are the ord, for I ill not be troubled ith you any more, says the Lord.
And as for the prophet and the priest and the people ho say, A ord of eight from the Lord! I ill send punishment on that man and on his house.
But this is hat you are to say, every man to his neighbour and every man to his brother, What anser has the Lord given? and, What has the Lord said?

And you ill no longer put people in mind of the ord of eight of the Lord: for every man’s ord ill be a eight on himself; for the ords of the living God, of the Lord of armies, our God, have been tisted by you.
This is hat you are to say to the prophet, What anser has the Lord given to you? and, What has the Lord said?
But if you say, The ord of eight of the Lord; this is hat the Lord has said: Because you say, The eight of the Lord, and I have sent to you, saying, You are not to say, The eight of the Lord;
For this reason, truly, I ill put you completely out of my memory, and I ill put you, and the ton hich I gave to you and to your fathers, aay from before my face:
And I ill give you a name ithout honour for ever, and unending shame hich ill never go from the memory of men.

The Lord gave me a vision, and I sa to baskets full of figs put in front of the Temple of the Lord, after Nebuchadrezzar, king of Babylon, had taken prisoner Jeconiah, the son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, and the chiefs of Judah, and the expert orkmen and metal-orkers from Jerusalem, and had taken them to Babylon.
One basket had very good figs, like the figs hich first come to groth: and the other basket had very bad figs, so bad that they ere of no use for food.
Then the Lord said to me, What do you see, Jeremiah? And I said, Figs; the good figs are very good, and the bad very bad, and of no use for food, they are so bad.
And the ord of the Lord came to me, saying,
This is hat the Lord, the God of Israel, has said: Like these good figs, so in my eyes ill be the prisoners of Judah, hom I have sent from this place into the land of the Chaldaeans for their good.
For I ill keep my eyes on them for good, and I ill take them back again to this land, building them up and not pulling them don, planting them and not uprooting them.
And I ill give them a heart to have knoledge of me, that I am the Lord: and they ill be my people, and I ill be their God: for they ill come back to me ith all their heart.

And like the bad figs hich are so bad that they are of no use for food, so I ill give up Zedekiah, king of Judah, and his chiefs and the rest of Jerusalem ho are still in this land, and those ho are in the land of Egypt:

I ill give them up to be a cause of fear and of trouble among all the kingdoms of the earth; to be a name of shame and common talk and a cutting ord and a curse in all the places herever I ill send them andering.
And I ill send the sord, and need of food, and disease, among them till they are all cut off from the land hich I gave to them and to their fathers.
The ord hich came to Jeremiah about all the people of Judah in the fourth year of Jehoiakim, the son of Josiah king of Judah; this as the first year of Nebuchadrezzar, king of Babylon.
This ord Jeremiah gave out to all the people of Judah and to those living in Jerusalem, saying,

From the thirteenth year of Josiah, the son of Amon, king of Judah, even till this day, for tenty-three years, the ord of the Lord has been coming to me, and I have given it to you, getting up early and talking to you; but you have not given ear.
And the Lord has sent to you all his servants the prophets, getting up early and sending them; but you have not given attention and your ear has not been open to give hearing;

Saying, Come back no, everyone from his evil ay and from the evil of your doings, and keep your place in the land hich the Lord has given to you and to your fathers, from times long past even for ever:
Do not go after other gods to be their servants and to give them orship, and do not make me angry ith the ork of your hands, causing evil to yourselves.
But you have not given ear to me, says the Lord; so that you have made me angry ith the ork of your hands, causing evil to yourselves.
So this is hat the Lord of armies has said: Because you have not given ear to my ords,

See, I ill send and take all the families of the north, says the Lord, and Nebuchadrezzar, king of Babylon, my servant, and make them come against this land, and against its people, and against all these nations on every side; and I ill give them up to complete destruction, and make them a cause of fear and surprise and a aste place for ever.

And more than this, I ill take from them the sound of laughing voices, the voice of joy, the voice of the nely-married man, and the voice of the bride, the sound of the stones crushing the grain, and the shining of lights.
All this land ill be a aste and a cause of onder; and these nations ill be the servants of the king of Babylon for seventy years.

And it ill come about, after seventy years are ended, that I ill send punishment on the king of Babylon, and on that nation, says the Lord, for their evil-doing, and on the land of the Chaldaeans; and I ill make it a aste for ever.
And I ill make that land undergo everything I have said against it, even everything recorded in this book, hich Jeremiah the prophet has said against all the nations.
For a number of nations and great kings ill make servants of them, even of them: and I ill give them the reard of their acts, even the reard of the ork of their hands.
For this is hat the Lord, the God of Israel, has said to me: Take the cup of the ine of this rath from my hand, and make all the nations to hom I send you take of it.
And after drinking it, they ill go rolling from side to side, and be off their heads, because of the sord hich I ill send among them.
Then I took the cup from the Lord’s hand, and gave a drink from it to all the nations to hom the Lord sent me;
Jerusalem and the tons of Judah and their kings and their princes, to make them a aste place, a cause of fear and surprise and a curse, as it is this day;

And give them orders to say to their masters, This is hat the Lord of armies, the God of Israel, has said: Say to your masters,

This is hat the Lord of armies, the God of Israel, has said to all those hom I have taken aay prisoners from Jerusalem to Babylon:

The ord hich came to Jeremiah from the Lord in the tenth year of Zedekiah, king of Judah, hich as the eighteenth year of Nebuchadrezzar.

For Zedekiah, king of Judah, had had him shut up, saying, Why have you, as a prophet, been saying, The Lord has said, See, I ill give this ton into the hands of the king of Babylon, and he ill take it;

And he ill take Zedekiah aay to Babylon, here he ill be till I have pity on him, says the Lord: though you are fighting ith the Chaldaeans, things ill not go ell for you?
And Jeremiah said, The ord of the Lord came to me, saying,
See, Hanamel, the son of Shallum, your father’s brother, ill come to you and say, Give the price and get for yourself my property in Anathoth: for you have the right of the nearest relation.

So Hanamel, the son of my father’s brother, came to me, as the Lord had said, to the place of the armed atchmen, and said to me, Give the price and get my property hich is in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin: for you have the nearest relation’s right to the heritage; so get it for yourself. Then it as clear to me that this as the ord of the Lord.
So I got for a price the property in Anathoth from Hanamel, the son of my father’s brother, and gave him the money, seventeen shekels of silver;
And I put it in riting, stamping it ith my stamp, and I took itnesses and put the money into the scales.
So I took the paper itnessing the business, one copy rolled up and stamped, and one copy open:

And I gave the paper to Baruch, the son of Neriah, the son of Mahseiah, before the eyes of Hanamel, the son of my father’s brother, and of the itnesses ho had put their names to the paper, and before all the Jes ho ere seated in the place of the armed atchmen.
And I gave orders to Baruch in front of them, saying,

This is hat the Lord of armies, the God of Israel, has said: Take these papers, the itness of this business, the one hich is rolled up and stamped, and the one hich is open; and put them in a vessel of earth so that they may be kept for a long time.
For the Lord of armies, the God of Israel, has said, There ill again be trading in houses and fields and vine-gardens in this land.
No after I had given the paper to Baruch, the son of Neriah, I made my prayer to the Lord, saying,
Ah Lord God! see, you have made the heaven and the earth by your great poer and by your outstretched arm, and there is nothing you are not able to do:
You have mercy on thousands, and send punishment for the evil-doing of the fathers on their children after them: the great, the strong God, the Lord of armies is his name:
Great in isdom and strong in act: hose eyes are open on all the ays of the sons of men, giving to everyone the reard of his ays and the fruit of his doings:
You have done signs and onders in the land of Egypt, and even to this day, in Israel and among other men; and have made a name for yourself as at this day;
And have taken your people Israel out of the land of Egypt ith signs and ith onders and ith a strong hand and an outstretched arm, causing great fear;
And have given them this land, hich you gave your ord to their fathers to give them, a land floing ith milk and honey;

And they came in and took it for their heritage, but they did not give ear to your voice, and ere not ruled by your la; they have done nothing of all you gave them orders to do: so you have made all this evil come on them:

See, they have made earthorks against the ton to take it; and the ton is given into the hands of the Chaldaeans ho are fighting against it, because of the sord and need of food and disease: and hat you have said has taken place, and truly you see it.
And you have said to me, Give the money to get yourself a property, and have the business itnessed; though the ton is given into the hands of the Chaldaeans.
And the ord of the Lord came to Jeremiah, saying,
See, I am the Lord, the God of all flesh: is there anything so hard that I am unable to do it?
So this is hat the Lord has said: See, I am giving this ton into the hands of the Chaldaeans and into the hands of Nebuchadrezzar, the king of Babylon, and he ill take it:

And the Chaldaeans, ho are fighting against this ton, ill come and put the ton on fire, burning it together ith the houses, on the roofs of hich perfumes have been burned to the Baal, and drink offerings have been drained out to other gods, moving me to rath.

For the children of Israel and the children of Judah have done nothing but evil in my eyes from their earliest years: the children of Israel have only made me angry ith the ork of their hands, says the Lord.
For this ton has been to me a cause of rath and of burning passion from the day of its building till this day, so that I put it aay from before my face:

Because of all the evil of the children of Israel and of the children of Judah, hich they have done to make me angry, they and their kings, their princes, their priests, and their prophets, and the men of Judah and the people of Jerusalem.
And they have been turning their backs and not their faces to me: and though I as their teacher, getting up early and teaching them, their ears ere not open to teaching.
But they put their disgusting images into the house hich is named by my name, making it unclean.

And they put up the high places of the Baal in the valley of the son of Hinnom, making their sons and their daughters go through the fire to Molech; hich I did not give them orders to do, and it never came into my mind that they ould do this disgusting thing, causing Judah to be turned out of the ay.
And no the Lord, the God of Israel, has said of this ton, about hich you say, It is given into the hands of the king of Babylon by the sord and by need of food and by disease:

See, I ill get them together from all the countries here I have sent them in my rath and in the heat of my passion and in my bitter feeling; and I ill let them come back into this place here they may take their rest safely.
And they ill be my people, and I ill be their God:
And I ill give them one heart and one ay, so that they may go on in the orship of me for ever, for their good and the good of their children after them:
And I ill make an eternal agreement ith them, that I ill never give them up, but ever do them good; and I ill put the fear of me in their hearts, so that they ill not go aay from me.
And truly, I ill take pleasure in doing them good, and all my heart and soul ill be given to planting them in this land in good faith.
For the Lord has said: As I have made all this great evil come on this people, so I ill send on them all the good hich I said about them.
And there ill be trading in fields in this land of hich you say, It is a aste, ithout man or beast; it is given into the hands of the Chaldaeans.

Men ill get fields for money, and put the business in riting, stamping the papers and having them itnessed, in the land of Benjamin and in the country round Jerusalem and in the tons of Judah and in the tons of the hill-country and in the tons of the loland and in the tons of the South: for I ill let their fate be changed, says the Lord.
Then the ord of the Lord came to Jeremiah the second time, hile he as still shut up in the place of the armed atchmen, saying,
These are the ords of the Lord, ho is doing it, the Lord ho is forming it, to make it certain; the Lord is his name;
Let your cry come to me, and I ill give you an anser, and let you see great things and secret things of hich you had no knoledge.
For this is hat the Lord, the God of Israel, has said about the houses of this ton and the houses of the kings of Judah, hich have been broken don to make earthorks and ... ;
... and to make them full of the dead bodies of men hom I have put to death in my rath and in my passion, and because of hose evil-doing I have kept my face covered from this ton.
See, I ill make it healthy and ell again, I ill even make them ell; I ill let them see peace and good faith in full measure.
And I ill let the fate of Judah and of Israel be changed, building them up as at first.

And I ill make them clean from all their sin, ith hich they have been sinning against me; I ill have forgiveness for all their sins, ith hich they have been sinning against me, and ith hich they have done evil against me.

And this ton ill be to me for a name of joy, for a praise and a glory before all the nations of the earth, ho, hearing of all the good hich I am doing for them, ill be shaking ith fear because of all the good and the peace hich I am doing for it.

This is hat the Lord has said: There ill again be sounding in this place, of hich you say, It is a aste, ithout man and ithout beast; even in the tons of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem hich are aste and unpeopled, ithout man and ithout beast,

Happy sounds, the voice of joy, the voice of the nely-married man and the voice of the bride, the voices of those ho say, Give praise to the Lord of armies, for the Lord is good, for his mercy is unchanging for ever: the voices of those ho go ith praise into the house of the Lord. For I ill let the land come back to its first condition, says the Lord.

This is hat the Lord of armies has said: Again there ill be in this place, hich is a aste, ithout man and ithout beast, and in all its tons, a resting-place here the keepers of sheep ill make their flocks take rest.

In the tons of the hill-country, in the tons of the loland, and in the tons of the South and in the land of Benjamin and in the country round Jerusalem and in the tons of Judah, the flocks ill again go under the hand of him ho is numbering them, says the Lord.
See, the days are coming, says the Lord, hen I ill give effect to the good ord hich I have said about the people of Israel and the people of Judah.
In those days and at that time, I ill let a Branch of righteousness come up for David; and he ill be a judge in righteousness in the land.
In those days, Judah ill have salvation and Jerusalem ill be safe: and this is the name hich ill be given to her: The Lord is our righteousness.
For the Lord has said, David ill never be ithout a man to take his place on the seat of the kingdom of Israel;
And the priests and the Levites ill never be ithout a man to come before me, offering burned offerings and perfumes and meal offerings and offerings of beasts at all times.
And the ord of the Lord came to Jeremiah, saying,
The Lord has said: If it is possible for my agreement of the day and the night to be broken, so that day and night no longer come at their fixed times,
Then my agreement ith my servant David may be broken, so that he no longer has a son to take his place on the seat of the kingdom; and my agreement ith the Levites, the priests, my servants.
As it is not possible for the army of heaven to be numbered, or the sand of the sea measured, so ill I make the seed of my servant David, and the Levites my servants.
And the ord of the Lord came to Jeremiah, saying,

Have you taken note of hat these people have said, The to families, hich the Lord took for himself, he has given up? This they say, looking don on my people as being, in their eyes, no longer a nation.
The Lord has said, If I have not made day and night, and if the limits of heaven and earth have not been fixed by me,

Then I ill give up caring for the seed of Jacob and of David my servant, so that I ill not take of his seed to be rulers over the seed of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob: for I ill let their fate be changed and ill have mercy on them.

The ord hich came to Jeremiah from the Lord, hen Nebuchadrezzar, king of Babylon, and all his army, and all the kingdoms of the earth hich ere under his rule, and all the peoples, ere fighting against Jerusalem and all its tons, saying,

The Lord, the God of Israel, has said, Go and say to Zedekiah, king of Judah, This is hat the Lord has said: See, I ill give this ton into the hands of the king of Babylon, and he ill have it burned ith fire:

And you ill not get aay from him, but ill certainly be taken and given up into his hands; and you ill see the king of Babylon, eye to eye, and he ill have talk ith you, mouth to mouth, and you ill go to Babylon.
But give ear to the ord of the Lord, O Zedekiah, king of Judah; this is hat the Lord has said about you: Death ill not come to you by the sord:

You ill come to your end in peace; and such burnings as they made for your fathers, the earlier kings before you, ill be made for you; and they ill be eeping for you and saying, Ah lord! for I have said the ord, says the Lord.
Then Jeremiah the prophet said all these things to Zedekiah, king of Judah, in Jerusalem,

When the army of the king of Babylon as fighting against Jerusalem and against all the tons of Judah hich had not been taken, against Lachish and against Azekah; for these ere the last of the alled tons of Judah.
The ord hich came to Jeremiah from the Lord, after King Zedekiah had made an agreement ith all the people in Jerusalem, to give nes in public that servants ere to be made free;
That every man as to let his Hebre man-servant and his Hebre servant-girl go free; so that no one might make use of a Je, his countryman, as a servant:

And this as done by all the rulers and the people ho had taken part in the agreement, and every one let his man-servant and his servant-girl go free, not to be used as servants any longer; they did so, and let them go.
But later, they took back again the servants and the servant-girls hom they had let go free, and put them again under the yoke as servants and servant-girls.
For this reason the ord of the Lord came to Jeremiah from the Lord, saying,
The Lord, the God of Israel, has said, I made an agreement ith your fathers on the day hen I took them out of Egypt, out of the prison-house, saying,

At the end of seven years every man is to let go his countryman ho is a Hebre, ho has become yours for a price and has been your servant for six years; you are to let him go free: but your fathers gave no attention and did not give ear.

And no, turning aay from evil, you had done hat is right in my eyes, giving a public undertaking for every man to make his neighbour free; and you had made an agreement before me in the house hich is named by my name:

But again you have put shame on my name, and you have taken back, every one his man-servant and his servant-girl, hom you had sent aay free, and you have put them under the yoke again to be your servants and servant-girls.

And so the Lord has said, You have not given ear to me and undertaken publicly, every man to let loose his countryman and his neighbour: see, I undertake to let loose against you the sord and disease and need of food; and I ill send you andering among all the kingdoms of the earth.
And I ill give the men ho have gone against my agreement and have not given effect to the ords of the agreement hich they made before me, hen the ox as cut in to and they ent beteen the parts of it,
The rulers of Judah and the rulers of Jerusalem, the unsexed servants and the priests and all the people of the land ho ent beteen the parts of the ox,

Even these I ill give up into the hands of their haters and into the hands of those ho have designs against their lives: and their dead bodies ill become food for the birds of heaven and the beasts of the earth.

And Zedekiah, king of Judah, and his rulers I ill give into the hands of their haters and into the hands of those ho have designs against their lives, and into the hands of the king of Babylon’s army hich has gone aay from you.

The ord hich came to Jeremiah from the Lord, in the days of Jehoiakim, the son of Josiah, king of Judah, saying,

No it came about in the fourth year of Jehoiakim, the son of Josiah, king of Judah, that this ord came to Jeremiah from the Lord, saying,

Then Jeremiah sent for Baruch, the son of Neriah; and Baruch took don from the mouth of Jeremiah all the ords of the Lord hich he had said to him, riting them in a book.
And Jeremiah gave orders to Baruch, saying, I am shut up, and am not able to go into the house of the Lord:

So you are to go, reading there from the book, hich you have taken don from my mouth, the ords of the Lord, in the hearing of the people in the Lord’s house, on a day hen they go ithout food, and in the hearing of all the men of Judah ho have come out from their tons.

And Ebed-melech ent out from the king’s house and said to the king,
