( And the life as made clear to us, and e have seen it and are itnessing to it and giving you ord of that eternal life hich as ith the Father and as seen by us);
We give you ord of all e have seen and everything hich has come to our ears, so that you may be united ith us; and e are united ith the Father and ith his Son Jesus Christ:
And e are riting these things to you so that our joy may be made complete.
This is the ord hich came to us from him and hich e give to you, that God is light and in him there is nothing dark.
If e say e are joined to him, and are alking still in the dark, our ords are false and our acts are untrue:
But if e are alking in the light, as he is in the light, e are all united ith one another, and the blood of Jesus his Son makes us clean from all sin.
If e say that e have no sin, e are false to ourselves and there is nothing true in us.
If e say openly that e have done rong, he is upright and true to his ord, giving us forgiveness of sins and making us clean from all evil.
If e say that e have no sin, e make him false and his ord is not in us.
My little children, I am riting these things to you so that you may be ithout sin. And if any man is a sinner, e have a friend and helper ith the Father, Jesus Christ, the upright one:
He is the offering for our sins; and not for ours only, but for all the orld.
And by this e may be certain that e have knoledge of him, if e keep his las.
The man ho says, I have knoledge of him, and does not keep his las, is false, and there is nothing true in him:
But in every man ho keeps his ord, the love of God is made complete. By this e may be certain that e are in him:
He ho says that he is living in him, ill do as he did.
My loved ones, I do not give you a ne la, but an old la hich you had from the first; this old la is the ord hich came to your ears.
Again, I give you a ne la, hich is true in him and in you; for the night is near its end and the true light is even no shining out.
He ho says that he is in the light, and has hate in his heart for his brother, is still in the dark.
He ho has love for his brother is in the light, and there is no cause of error in him.
But he ho has hate for his brother is in the dark, alking in the dark ith no knoledge of here he is going, unable to see because of the dark.
I am riting to you, my children, because you have forgiveness of sins through his name.

I am riting to you, fathers, because you have knoledge of him ho as from the first. I am riting to you, young men, because you have overcome the Evil One. I have sent a letter to you, children, because you have knoledge of the Father.

I have sent a letter to you, fathers, because you have knoledge of him ho as from the first. I have sent a letter to you, young men, because you are strong, and the ord of God is in you, and because you have overcome the Evil One.
Have no love for the orld or for the things hich are in the orld. If any man has love for the orld, the love of the Father is not in him.
Because everything in the orld, the desire of the flesh, the desire of the eyes, and the pride of life, is not of the Father but of the orld.
And the orld and its desires is coming to an end: but he ho does God’s pleasure is living for ever.
Little children, it is the last hour; and as you ere given ord that the Antichrist ould come, so no a number of Antichrists have come to you; and by this e are certain that it is the last hour.
They ent out from us but they ere not of us; if they had been of us they ould still be ith us: but they ent out from us so that it might be made clear that they ere not of us.
And you have the Spirit from the Holy One and you all have knoledge.
I have not sent you this letter because you have no knoledge of hat is true, but because you have knoledge, and because that hich is false has nothing in common ith that hich is true.
Who is false but he ho says that Jesus is not the Christ? He is the Antichrist ho has no belief in the Father or the Son.
He ho has no belief in the Son has not the Father: he ho makes clear his belief in the Son has the Father.
But as for you, keep in your hearts the things hich ere made clear to you from the first. If you keep these things in your hearts you ill be kept in the Father and the Son.
And this is the hope hich he gave you, even eternal life.
I am riting these things to you about those hose purpose is that you may be turned out of the true ay.

As for you, the Spirit hich he gave you is still in you, and you have no need of any teacher; but as his Spirit gives you teaching about all things, and is true and not false, so keep your hearts in him, through the teaching hich he has given you.
And no, my children, keep your hearts in him; so that at his revelation, e may have no fear or shame before him at his coming.
If you have knoledge that he is upright, it is clear to you that everyone ho does righteousness is his offspring.
See hat great love the Father has given us in naming us the children of God; and such e are. For this reason the orld does not see ho e are, because it did not see ho he as.
My loved ones, no e are children of God, and at present it is not clear hat e are to be. We are certain that at his revelation e ill be like him; for e ill see him as he is.
And everyone ho has this hope in him makes himself holy, even as he is holy.
Everyone ho is a sinner goes against the la, for sin is going against the la.
And you have knoledge that he came to take aay sin: and in him there is no sin.
Anyone ho is in him does no sin; anyone ho is a sinner has not seen him and has no knoledge of him.
My little children, let no man take you out of the true ay: he ho does righteousness is upright, even as he is upright;
The sinner is a child of the Evil One; for the Evil One has been a sinner from the first. And the Son of God as seen on earth so that he might put an end to the orks of the Evil One.
Anyone ho is a child of God does no sin, because he still has God’s seed in him; he is not able to be a sinner, because God is his Father.
In this ay it is clear ho are the children of God and ho are the children of the Evil One; anyone ho does not do righteousness or ho has no love for his brother, is not a child of God.
Because this is the ord hich as given to you from the first, that e are to have love for one another;
Not being of the Evil One like Cain, ho put his brother to death. And hy did he put him to death? Because his orks ere evil and his brother’s orks ere good.
Do not be surprised, my brothers, if the orld has no love for you.
We are conscious that e have come out of death into life because of our love for the brothers. He ho has no love is still in death.
Anyone ho has hate for his brother is a taker of life, and you may be certain that no taker of life has eternal life in him.
In this e see hat love is, because he gave his life for us; and it is right for us to give our lives for the brothers.
But if a man has this orld’s goods, and sees that his brother is in need, and keeps his heart shut against his brother, ho is it possible for the love of God to be in him?
My little children, do not let our love be in ord and in tongue, but let it be in act and in good faith.
In this ay e may be certain that e are true, and may give our heart comfort before him,
When our heart says that e have done rong; because God is greater than our heart, and has knoledge of all things.
My loved ones, if our heart does not say that e have done rong, e have no fear before him;
And he gives us all our requests, because e keep his las and do the things hich are pleasing in his eyes.
And this is his la, that e have faith in the name of his Son Jesus Christ, and love for one another, even as he said to us.
He ho keeps his las is in God and God is in him. And the Spirit hich he gave us is our itness that he is in us.
My loved ones, do not put your faith in every spirit, but put them to the test, to see if they are from God: because a great number of false prophets have gone out into the orld.
By this you may have knoledge of the Spirit of God: every spirit hich says that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is of God:
And every spirit hich does not say this is not from God: this is the spirit of Antichrist, of hich you have had ord; and it is in the orld even no.
You are of God, my little children, and you have overcome them because he ho is in you is greater than he ho is in the orld.
They are of the orld, so their talk is the orld’s talk, and the orld gives ear to them.
We are of God: he ho has the knoledge of God gives ear to us; he ho is not of God does not give ear to us. By this e may see hich is the true spirit, and hich is the spirit of error.
My loved ones, let us have love for one another: because love is of God, and everyone ho has love is a child of God and has knoledge of God.
He ho has no love has no knoledge of God, because God is love.
And the love of God as made clear to us hen he sent his only Son into the orld so that e might have life through him.
And this is love, not that e had love for God, but that he had love for us, and sent his Son to be an offering for our sins.
My loved ones, if God had such love for us, it is right for us to have love for one another.
No man has ever seen God: if e have love for one another, God is in us and his love is made complete in us:
And his Spirit hich he has given us is the itness that e are in him and he is in us.
And e have seen and give itness that the Father sent the Son to be the Saviour of the orld.
Everyone ho says openly that Jesus is the Son of God, has God in him and is in God.
And e have seen and had faith in the love hich God has for us. God is love, and everyone ho has love is in God, and God is in him.
In this ay love is made complete in us, so that e may be ithout fear on the day of judging, because as he is, so are e in this orld.
There is no fear in love: true love has no room for fear, because here fear is, there is pain; and he ho is not free from fear is not complete in love.
We have the poer of loving, because he first had love for us.
If a man says, I have love for God, and has hate for his brother, his ords are false: for ho is the man ho has no love for his brother hom he has seen, able to have love for God hom he has not seen?
And this is the ord hich e have from him, that he ho has love for God is to have the same love for his brother.
Everyone ho has faith that Jesus is the Christ is a child of God: and everyone ho has love for the Father has love for his child.
In this ay, e are certain that e have love for the children of God, hen e have love for God and keep his las.
For loving God is keeping his las: and his las are not hard.
Anything hich comes from God is able to overcome the orld: and the poer by hich e have overcome the orld is our faith.
Who is able to overcome the orld but the man ho has faith that Jesus is the Son of God?
This is he ho came by ater and by blood, Jesus Christ; not by ater only but by ater and by blood.
And the Spirit is the itness, because the Spirit is true.
There are three itnesses, the Spirit, the ater, and the blood: and all three are in agreement.
If e take the itness of men to be true, the itness of God is greater: because this is the itness hich God has given about his Son.
He ho has faith in the Son of God has the itness in himself: he ho has not faith in God makes him false, because he has not faith in the itness hich God has given about his Son.
And his itness is this, that God has given us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.
He ho has the Son has the life; he ho has not the Son of God has not the life.
I have put these things in riting for you ho have faith in the name of the Son of God, so that you may be certain that you have eternal life.
And e are certain that if e make any request to him hich is right in his eyes, he ill give ear to us:
And if e are certain that he gives ear to all our requests, e are equally certain that e ill get our requests.

If a man sees his brother doing a sin hich is not bad enough for death, let him make a prayer to God, and God ill give life to him hose sin as not bad enough for death. There is a sin hose punishment is death: I do not say that he may make such a request then.
All evil-doing is sin: but death is not the punishment for every sort of sin.
We are certain that one ho is a child of God ill do no sin, but the Son of God keeps him so that he is not touched by the Evil One.
We are certain that e are of God, but all the orld is in the poer of the Evil One.

And e are certain that the Son of God has come, and has given us a clear vision, so that e may see him ho is true, and e are in him ho is true, in his Son Jesus Christ. He is the true God and eternal life.
My little children, keep yourselves from false gods.
I, a ruler in the church, send ord to the noble sister ho is of God’s selection, and to her children, for hom I have true love; and not only I, but all ho have knoledge of hat is true;
Because of this true knoledge hich is in us, and ill be ith us for ever:
May grace, mercy, and peace be ith us from God the Father, and from Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in all true love.
It gave me great joy to see some of your children alking in the true ay, even as e ere ordered to do by the Father.
And no, my sister, I make a request to you, not sending you a ne la, but the la hich e had from the first, that e have love for one another.
And love is the keeping of his las. This is the la hich as given to you from the first, so that you might keep it.
Because a number of false teachers have gone out into the orld, ho do not give itness that Jesus Christ came in the flesh. Such a one is a false teacher and Antichrist.
Keep atch over yourselves, so that you do not make our ork of no effect, but may get your full reard.
Anyone ho goes on and does not keep to the teaching of Christ, has not God: he ho keeps to the teaching has the Father and the Son.
If anyone comes to you not having this teaching, do not take him into your house or give him ords of love:
For he ho gives him ords of love has a part in his evil orks.
Having much to say to you, it is not my purpose to put it all don ith paper and ink: but I am hoping to come to you, and to have talk ith you face to face, so that your joy may be full.
The children of your noble sister, ho is of God’s selection, send you their love.
I, a ruler in the church, send ord to the ell loved Gaius, for hom I have true love.
My loved one, it is my prayer that you may do ell in all things, and be healthy in body, even as your soul does ell.
For it gave me great joy hen some of the brothers came and gave itness that you had the true faith and ere alking in the true ay.
I have no greater joy than to have nes that my children are alking in the true ay.
My loved one, you are doing a good ork in being kind to those brothers ho come from other places;
Who have given itness to the church of your love for them: and you ill do ell to send them on their ay ell cared for, as is right for servants of God:
For they ent out for love of the Name, taking nothing from the Gentiles.
So it is right for us to take in such men as guests, so that e may take our part in the ork of the true faith.
I sent a letter to the church, but Diotrephes, hose desire is ever to have the first place among them, ill not have us there.

So if I come, I ill keep in mind the things he does, talking against us ith evil ords: and as if this as not enough, he does not take the brothers into his house, and those ho are ready to take them in, he keeps from doing so, putting them out of the church if they do.
My loved one, do not be copying hat is evil, but hat is good. He ho does good is of God: he ho does evil has not seen God.
Demetrius has the approval of all men and of hat is true: and e give the same itness, and you are certain that our itness is true.
I had much to say to you, but it is not my purpose to put it all don ith ink and pen:
But I am hoping to see you in a short time, and to have talk ith you face to face. May you have peace. Your friends here send you their love. Give my love to our friends by name.
Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ and the brother of James, to those of God’s selection ho have been made holy by God the Father and are kept safe for Jesus Christ:
May mercy and peace and love be increased in you.

My loved ones, hile my thoughts ere full of a letter hich I as going to send you about our common salvation, it as necessary for me to send you one requesting you ith all my heart to go on fighting strongly for the faith hich has been given to the saints once and for ever.

For certain men have come among you secretly, marked out before in the holy Writings for this evil fate, men ithout the fear of God, turning his grace into an unclean thing, and false to our only Master and Lord, Jesus Christ.
No it is my purpose to put you in mind, though you once had knoledge of all these things, of ho the Lord, having taken a people safely out of Egypt, later sent destruction on those ho had no faith;
And the angels ho did not keep to their kingdom but ent out from the place hich as theirs, he has put in eternal chains and in dark night till the great day of the judging.

Even as Sodom and Gomorrah, and the tons near them, having like these, given themselves up to unclean desires and gone after strange flesh, have been made an example, undergoing the punishment of eternal fire.
In the same ay these dreamers make the flesh unclean, having no respect for authorities, and say evil of rulers.
No hen Michael, one of the chief angels, as fighting against the Evil One for the body of Moses, fearing to make use of violent ords against him, he only said, May the Lord be your judge.
But these men say evil about such things as they have no knoledge of; and the things of hich they have natural knoledge, like beasts ithout reason, are the cause of their destruction.
A curse on them! They have gone in the ay of Cain, running uncontrolled into the error of Balaam for reard, and have come to destruction by saying evil against the Lord, like Korah.

These men are unseen rocks at your love-feasts, hen they take part in them ith you, keepers of sheep ho ithout fear take the food of the sheep; clouds ithout ater rushing before the ind, asted trees ithout fruit, tice dead, pulled up by the roots,
Violent aves of the sea, streaming ith their shame, andering stars for hom the darkest night is kept in store for ever.
The prophet Enoch, ho as the seventh after Adam, said of these men, The Lord came ith tens of thousands of his saints,

To be the judge of all, and to give a decision against all those hose lives are unpleasing to him, because of the evil acts hich they have done, and because of all the hard things hich sinners ithout fear of God have said against him.
These are the men ho make trouble, ever desiring change, going after evil pleasures, using high-sounding ords, respecting men’s position in the hope of reard.
But you, my loved ones, keep in memory the ords hich ere said before by the Apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ,
Ho they said to you, In the last days there ill be men ho, guided by their evil desires, ill make sport of holy things.
These are the men ho make divisions, natural men, not having the Spirit.
But you, my loved ones, building yourselves up on your most holy faith, and making prayers in the Holy Spirit,
Keep yourselves in the love of God, looking for life eternal through the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ.
And have pity on those ho are in doubt;
And to some give salvation, pulling them out of the fire; and on some have mercy ith fear, hating even the clothing hich is made unclean by the flesh.
No to him ho is able to keep you from falling, and to give you a place in his glory, free from all evil, ith great joy,
To the only God our Saviour, through Jesus Christ our Lord, let us give glory and honour and authority and poer, before all time and no and for ever. So be it.
The Revelation of Jesus Christ hich God gave him so that his servants might have knoledge of the things hich ill quickly take place: and he sent and made it clear by his angel to his servant John;
Who gave itness of the ord of God, and of the itness of Jesus Christ, even of all the things hich he sa.
A blessing be on the reader, and on those ho give ear to the prophet’s ords, and keep the things hich he has put in the book: for the time is near.
John to the seven churches hich are in Asia: Grace to you and peace, from him ho is and as and is to come; and from the seven Spirits hich are before his high seat;
And from Jesus Christ, the true itness, the first to come back from the dead, and the ruler of the kings of the earth. To him ho had love for us and has made us clean from our sins by his blood;
And has made us to be a kingdom and priests to his God and Father; to him let glory and poer be given for ever and ever. So be it.
See, he comes ith the clouds, and every eye ill see him, and those by hom he as ounded; and all the tribes of the earth ill be sorroing because of him. Yes, so be it.
I am the First and the Last, says the Lord God ho is and as and is to come, the Ruler of all.
I, John, your brother, ho have a part ith you in the trouble and the kingdom and the quiet strength of Jesus, as in the island hich is named Patmos, for the ord of God and the itness of Jesus.
I as in the Spirit on the Lord’s day, and a great voice at my back, as of a horn, came to my ears,
Saying, What you see, put in a book, and send it to the seven churches; to Ephesus and to Smyrna and to Pergamos and to Thyatira and to Sardis and to Philadelphia and to Laodicea.
And turning to see the voice hich said these ords to me, I sa seven gold vessels ith lights burning in them;
And in the middle of them one like a son of man, clothed ith a robe don to his feet, and ith a band of gold round his breasts.
And his head and his hair ere hite like ool, as hite as sno; and his eyes ere as a flame of fire;
And his feet like polished brass, as if it had been burned in a fire; and his voice as as the sound of great aters.
And he had in his right hand seven stars: and out of his mouth came a sharp to-edged sord: and his face as like the sun shining in its strength.
And hen I sa him, I ent don on my face at his feet as one dead. And he put his right hand on me, saying, Have no fear; I am the first and the last and the Living one;
And I as dead, and see, I am living for ever, and I have the keys of death and of Hell.
Put in riting, then, the things hich you have seen, and the things hich are, and the things hich ill be after these;

The secret of the seven stars hich you sa in my right hand, and of the seven gold vessels ith burning lights. The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches: and the seven lights are the seven churches.
To the angel of the church in Ephesus say: These things says he ho has the seven stars in his right hand, ho is alking in the middle of the seven gold lights:

I have knoledge of your doings, and of your hard ork and long aiting, and that you ill not put up ith evil men, and have put to the test those ho say they are Apostles and are not, and have seen that they are false;
And you have the poer of aiting, and have undergone trouble because of my name, ithout eariness.
But I have this against you, that you are turned aay from your first love.
So keep in mind here you ere at first, and be changed in heart and do the first orks; or I ill come to you, and ill take aay your light from its place, if your hearts are not changed.
But at least you have the credit of hating the orks of the Nicolaitans, as I do.
He ho has ears, let him give ear to hat the Spirit says to the churches. To him ho overcomes I ill give of the fruit of the tree of life, hich is in the Paradise of God.
And to the angel of the church in Smyrna say: These things says the first and the last, ho as dead and is living:
I have knoledge of your troubles and ho poor you are ( but you have true ealth), and the evil ords of those ho say they are Jes, and are not, but are a Synagogue of Satan.

Have no fear of the things hich you ill have to undergo: see, the Evil One ill send some of you into prison, so that you may be put to the test; and you ill have great trouble for ten days. Be true till death, and I ill give you the cron of life.
He ho has ears, let him give ear to hat the Spirit says to the churches. He ho overcomes ill not come under the poer of the second death.
And to the angel of the church in Pergamos say: These things says he ho has the sharp to-edged sord:

I have knoledge that your living-place is here Satan has his seat: and you are true to my name, and ere not turned aay from your faith in me, even in the days of Antipas, my true itness, ho as put to death among you, here Satan has his place.

But I have some things against you, because you have ith you those ho keep the teaching of Balaam, by hose suggestion Balak made the children of Israel go out of the right ay, taking food hich as offered to false gods, and going after the desires of the flesh.
And you have those ho keep the teaching of the Nicolaitans.
See, then, that you have a change of heart; or I ill come to you quickly, and ill make ar against them ith the sord of my mouth.

He ho has ears, let him give ear to hat the Spirit says to the churches. To him ho overcomes I ill give of the secret manna, and I ill give him a hite stone, and on the stone a ne name, of hich no one has knoledge but he to hom it is given.
And to the angel of the church in Thyatira say: These things says the Son of God, hose eyes are like a flame of fire, and his feet like polished brass:
I have knoledge of your orks, and your love and faith and help and strength in trouble, and that your last orks are more than the first.
But I have this against you, that you let the oman Jezebel say she is a prophet and give false teaching, making my servants go after the desires of the flesh and take food offered to false gods.
And I gave her time for a change of heart, but she has no mind to give up her unclean ays.
See, I ill put her into a bed, and those ho make themselves unclean ith her, into great trouble, if they go on ith her orks.
And I ill put her children to death; and all the churches ill see that I am he ho makes search into the secret thoughts and hearts of men: and I ill give to every one of you the reard of your orks.
But to you I say, to the rest in Thyatira, even to those ho have not this teaching, and have no knoledge of the secrets of Satan, as they say; I put on you no other eight.
But hat you have, keep safe till I come.
He ho overcomes, and keeps my orks to the end, to him I ill give rule over the nations,
And he ill be ruling them ith a rod of iron; as the vessels of the potter they ill be broken, even as I have poer from my Father:
And I ill give him the morning star.
He ho has ears, let him give ear to hat the Spirit says to the churches.
And to the angel of the church in Sardis say: These things says he ho has the seven Spirits of God and the seven stars: I have knoledge of your orks, that you seem to be living but are dead.
Be on the atch, and make strong the rest of the things hich are near to death; because as judged by me your orks have not come up to God’s measure.

Keep in mind, then, the teaching hich as given to you, and be ruled by it and have a change of heart. If then you do not keep atch, I ill come like a thief, and you ill have no knoledge of the hour hen I ill come on you.
But you have some names in Sardis ho have kept clean their robes; and as a reard they ill go in hite ith me.
He ho overcomes ill be dressed in hite, and I ill not take his name from the book of life, and I ill give itness to his name before my Father, and before his angels.
He ho has ears, let him give ear to hat the Spirit says to the churches.

And to the angel of the church in Philadelphia say: These things says he ho is holy, he ho is true, he ho has the key of David, opening the door so that it may be shut by no one, and shutting it so that it may be open to no one.
I have knoledge of your orks ( see, I have put before you an open door hich may be shut by no one), and that you have a little strength, and have kept my ord, and have been true to my name.
See, I ill make those of the Synagogue of Satan ho say they are Jes, and are not, but say hat is false; I ill make them come and give orship before your feet, and see my love for you.
Because you have kept my ord in quiet strength, I ill keep you from the hour of testing hich is coming on all the orld, to put to the test those ho are on earth.
I come quickly: keep that hich you have, so that no one may take your cron.
